PAGE INSTR:
## Products Page — Full Visual Design Direction

### Page Role & Goal
This is the full product catalog for Lava Mouth — a scrolling celebration of six small-batch hot sauces, each treated as a distinct personality rather than a SKU. The page must feel like walking through a loud, joyful market stall where every bottle is calling for attention. The Memphis Playful aesthetic is deployed at full amplitude: confetti shapes, bold color blocks, patterned surfaces, and display typography doing structural work, not just decorative work.

---

### Section Sequence & Rhythm

**Section 1 — Page Header:** Dense, loud, pattern-saturated arrival. Full-bleed Memphis tile pattern behind a left-aligned masthead-style type treatment. High energy, maximum graphic density. No whitespace padding relief — the pattern fills edge to edge.

**Section 2 — Product Grid:** The page's longest and most structurally complex section. A staggered, asymmetric card grid where each sauce card has a distinct dominant color pulled from the palette. Cards are not identical columns — they vary in vertical offset and size weight to feel like a hand-arranged market display. This is the densest content section.

**Section 3 — Heat Comparison:** A deliberate shift in rhythm — wider breathing room, a single bold horizontal heat-scale chart dominates the layout. This is the page's **signature moment** (described below). The section is structured as a side-tabbed layout: the five heat tiers stack vertically on the left as a labeled index, while the chart and sauce names occupy the right two-thirds. Moderately sparse compared to Section 2.

**Section 4 — Testimonials:** Full-bleed Ghost Pepper Purple panel. Three testimonial quotes arranged in an off-axis staggered layout — not identical card columns. The section softens the energy slightly with genuine human voice but keeps the Memphis graphic energy alive through bold typographic pull quotes.

**Section 5 — CTA Close:** A punchy, asymmetric close on a Habanero Yellow background. Oversized display headline, two CTA buttons, and a burst of confetti shapes overlapping the panel boundary. Short, urgent, fun.

---

### Signature Moment

**Named: "The Flame Scale Takeover" — Section 3, Heat Comparison.**

The heat scale chart (a Memphis-illustrated horizontal gradient bar from Habanero Yellow through Molten Coral to a deep red-black) is rendered at oversized, page-dominating width — it bleeds past the text column and nearly reaches the page edge on both sides, breaking the section's grid containment. The five flame-tier labels are set in Boogaloo at 36px, stacked vertically on the left as a bold index column in alternating Jalapeño Teal and Molten Coral fills. The chart bar itself is thick — approximately 80–100px tall — with flame icons at each tier node rendered as oversized Memphis graphic shapes (not emoji, not icons — bold flat-color illustrated flames in the brand palette). The sauce name for each tier is annotated in Permanent Marker directly on or just below the bar at each node, like a hand-stamped label. This move is unmistakably Memphis: it treats a data visualization as a graphic design object, uses color and scale as structural tools, and turns a utilitarian comparison into a page-defining visual moment. No other aesthetic would produce this exact gesture.

---

### Signature Motion Moment

**Named: "The Flame Bar Ignition" — Section 3.**

When the heat scale section scrolls into view, the gradient bar animates from left to right as if being drawn or filled in real time — starting at the cool yellow end and "burning" across to the deep red extreme over approximately 1.2 seconds. Each flame icon at the five tier nodes pops in sequentially, one beat apart, with a brief upward bounce (scale from 0.5 to 1.1 then settle to 1.0) timed to the bar's fill reaching that node. The tier labels on the left index slide in from the left, staggered one after another. This motion is tied directly to the signature visual moment and reinforces the heat-progression narrative — the animation tells the story of escalating heat before the visitor reads a word.

---

### Color & Surface Usage Across the Page

- **Section 1 (Header):** Lava Cream background with the Memphis tile pattern rendered in Habanero Yellow, Confetti Pink, Jalapeño Teal, and Smoke Ring Black line-work. Headline in Molten Coral on the cream/pattern surface. Eyebrow pill in Confetti Pink.
- **Section 2 (Grid):** Lava Cream page background. Each product card has its own dominant background color pulled from the palette in rotation: Serrano Verde → Jalapeño Teal card; Smoky Diablo → Smoke Ring Black card; Mango Inferno → Habanero Yellow card; Pineapple Fury → Confetti Pink card; Ghost Town → Ghost Pepper Purple card; Carolina Reaper's Edge → Molten Coral card. Headline text on dark cards in Lava Cream or Habanero Yellow; on light cards in Smoke Ring Black. Section eyebrow and headline in Smoke Ring Black on Lava Cream above the grid.
- **Section 3 (Comparison):** Lava Cream background. The heat bar is the color hero — yellow to coral gradient. Left index column text alternates Jalapeño Teal and Molten Coral fills. Permanent Marker annotations in Smoke Ring Black on the bar.
- **Section 4 (Testimonials):** Full-bleed Ghost Pepper Purple background. Quote text in Lava Cream. Attribution in Habanero Yellow. Decorative squiggles and confetti dots in Confetti Pink and Molten Coral scattered around the panel.
- **Section 5 (CTA):** Full-bleed Habanero Yellow background. Headline in Smoke Ring Black (maximum contrast). Primary CTA button in Molten Coral with Lava Cream text; secondary CTA in Smoke Ring Black with Lava Cream text. Confetti shapes in Ghost Pepper Purple and Jalapeño Teal overlapping the top and bottom edges of the panel.

---

### Typographic Hierarchy & Expressive Moves

- **Boogaloo** at 80–100px (H1 equivalent) for the page header headline. At 52–64px for section headlines in Sections 2 and 3. At 36–42px for product card titles and heat-tier labels. All-caps for the page header and CTA headline; sentence case for product card titles and comparison tiers.
- **Nunito** at 16–18px, semi-bold 600 for product descriptions and body copy in the comparison section. Regular 400 for testimonial quote text.
- **Permanent Marker** at 11–14px for eyebrow labels (pill backgrounds in Confetti Pink), heat-scale bar annotations, and the "Ready to Commit?" eyebrow in Section 5. Loose letter-spacing. Never at heading scale.
- The product card titles in Section 2 use Boogaloo with color fills matching the card's palette role — e.g., Habanero Yellow title on the Ghost Pepper Purple Ghost Town card, Smoke Ring Black title on the Habanero Yellow Mango Inferno card.
- The CTA headline in Section 5 ("Your Kitchen Needs This") is set at 80px Boogaloo, all-caps, in Smoke Ring Black — the largest type on the page after the header, and deliberately off-center aligned to the left third of the panel.

---

### Density & Whitespace Logic

The page follows a deliberate dense → dense → airy → full-bleed → punchy rhythm:
- Section 1: Dense (pattern-saturated, minimal padding)
- Section 2: Dense (six cards, staggered grid, rich metadata)
- Section 3: Moderate breathing room (chart dominates, generous vertical padding around the bar)
- Section 4: Full-bleed color block (contained density within the purple panel, but the panel itself is a relief from the grid)
- Section 5: Short and punchy (minimal copy, maximum type scale, fast exit)

---

### Motion Design — Full Page Arc

**On-load arc (Section 1):**
The Memphis tile pattern fades in first as the page loads, appearing over about 0.4 seconds. The eyebrow pill slides down from slightly above its resting position. The main headline ("Every Sauce Has a Story") scales up from 90% to 100% and fades in — arriving bold and settled. The subheadline follows a beat later with a gentle upward slide.

**Scroll-triggered reveals:**
- Section 2: Each product card slides up and fades in as the grid enters the viewport, staggered left-to-right, top row first then bottom row, with approximately a half-beat between each card. Children (title, description, metadata tags) do not animate separately — the card as a unit is the reveal.
- Section 3: The "Flame Bar Ignition" signature motion (described above) triggers when the chart enters the viewport.
- Section 4: The full purple panel fades in as a block. The three testimonial quotes then slide up from below in sequence, one beat apart.
- Section 5: The confetti shapes scatter in from the top and bottom edges (scale from 0 to 1) as the CTA panel enters view. The headline and buttons follow immediately after.

**Hover & focus affordances:**
- Product cards (Section 2): On hover, the card lifts 6px with a deepened drop shadow (Smoke Ring Black at 20% opacity, larger spread). The card's dominant background color lightens by about 10% (achieved via a semi-transparent white overlay). The "Find a Stockist" CTA button at the bottom of the grid shifts from a Molten Coral fill to a Ghost Pepper Purple fill on hover, with Lava Cream text maintained.
- Heat tier rows (Section 3): On hover, the hovered tier row highlights with a Habanero Yellow left border (4px) and the sauce name annotation on the bar pulses briefly (quick scale to 1.05 and back).
- Testimonial cards (Section 4): Subtle — the card background lightens from Ghost Pepper Purple to a slightly lighter purple tint on hover, and the attribution text shifts from Habanero Yellow to Lava Cream.
- CTA buttons (Section 5): Primary button lifts 4px with a Smoke Ring Black shadow on hover. Secondary button inverts fill and text color on hover.

**Ambient looped motion:**
- The Memphis tile pattern in Section 1 very slowly drifts — the entire pattern translates diagonally (down-right) at a glacial pace, completing one tile-width of movement over about 12 seconds, then looping seamlessly. This creates a living, breathing header surface.
- A horizontal marquee strip runs between Section 2 and Section 3 — a narrow Jalapeño Teal band carrying repeating text in Permanent Marker: "MILD · MEDIUM · HOT · EXTRA HOT · EXTREME · MILD · MEDIUM · HOT ·" scrolling left continuously at a steady, hypnotic pace. This acts as both a visual divider and an ambient motion element.
- The confetti shapes in Section 5 have a slow ambient float — each shape drifts up and down independently on a gentle sine-wave cycle (different phases per shape), giving the CTA panel a lively, celebratory energy.

---

### Responsive Behavior

- **Desktop (≥1280px):** Full staggered grid in Section 2 (3 columns, offset rows). Heat chart at full bleed width. Side-tabbed layout in Section 3.
- **Tablet (768–1279px):** Section 2 grid collapses to 2 columns, still staggered. Section 3 switches from side-tab to stacked (index above chart). Testimonials in Section 4 stack vertically.
- **Mobile (<768px):** Section 2 is a single-column scroll of cards, each full-width. The heat chart in Section 3 scales down but remains the dominant element; the tier index stacks above it. All display type scales down proportionally (H1 to ~52px, H2 to ~36px). The marquee strip between sections remains full-width and scrolling. Confetti shapes in Section 5 reduce in quantity to avoid clutter.

---

### Fit Within Shared Design System

This page uses all eight palette colors across its five sections — no color is left idle. The typographic trio (Boogaloo, Nunito, Permanent Marker) is deployed at every scale level appropriate to each. The Memphis visual cues (patterned backgrounds, confetti shapes, squiggles, bright blocks) are structural devices here — the pattern is the header background, the color blocks are the card identities, the confetti shapes are the CTA's decorative architecture. The page is unmistakably Lava Mouth: loud, joyful, irreverent, and warm — with every visual decision traceable to the Memphis Playful aesthetic and the Storytelling Scroll layout's sequential, narrative momentum.
===

SECTION ID: products-section-1
**Section 1 — Page Header (products-section-1)**

This is a masthead-style arrival panel, not a conventional split hero. The section is full-bleed edge-to-edge with zero margin relief on the sides — the Memphis tile pattern asset fills the entire background surface at 100% viewport width and a fixed height of approximately 420px on desktop (320px on tablet, 280px on mobile).

**Background pattern asset:** The repeating Memphis tile pattern (tiny chili peppers, flame shapes, zigzag lines, polka dots) is rendered behind all content. The tile is dense and energetic. Colors in the pattern: Habanero Yellow shapes, Confetti Pink dots, Jalapeño Teal zigzags, and Smoke Ring Black line-work on a Lava Cream base tile. The pattern animates with a slow ambient drift — the entire tile translates diagonally (down and to the right) over 12 seconds, completing exactly one tile-unit of travel before looping seamlessly. This makes the header feel alive and kinetic from the moment the page loads.

**Content layout:** All text is left-aligned, positioned in the left 55% of the panel on desktop. No right-side illustration or image — the pattern IS the visual. Generous left padding (80px on desktop, 48px on tablet, 24px on mobile).

**Eyebrow:** 'The Full Lineup' — rendered as a pill-shaped label in Permanent Marker at 13px, loose letter-spacing (0.08em), Smoke Ring Black text on a Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) pill background. Pill has 8px vertical padding and 16px horizontal padding, 999px border-radius. Positioned at the top of the text block.

**Headline:** 'Every Sauce Has a Story' — Boogaloo at 88px on desktop (sentence case, not all-caps — this is editorial, not a shout). Color: Molten Coral (#FF4D38) fill. Zero tracking. The headline sits directly below the eyebrow pill with 16px gap. The Molten Coral against the patterned Lava Cream background creates maximum graphic impact without being harsh.

**Subheadline:** 'Small batches. Big personalities. Zero filler. Here's the whole crew.' — Nunito at 20px, semi-bold 600, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209). Line-height 1.5. Positioned 20px below the headline. Maximum width 520px to keep the measure tight and punchy.

**On-load animation:** The pattern fades in first (0.4s). The eyebrow pill slides down from 12px above its resting position and fades in simultaneously. The headline scales from 92% to 100% and fades in, arriving approximately 0.3s after the eyebrow settles. The subheadline slides up 10px and fades in a beat after the headline is fully settled. No CTA in this section — no button needed here.

**Bottom edge treatment:** The section bottom is terminated by a thick 6px horizontal rule in Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) that runs full-width, acting as a structural divider and signaling the transition into the product grid below. This rule is part of the section, not a separate element.
---

SECTION ID: products-section-2
**Section 2 — Product Item Grid (products-section-2)**

This is the page's densest and most complex section — a staggered, asymmetric card grid where each of the six sauce cards has a distinct dominant background color and feels like a collectible label with its own personality. This is NOT a uniform three-column grid of identical cards.

**Section header (above the grid):**
Left-aligned. Eyebrow: 'Mild to Wild' in Permanent Marker at 13px, Smoke Ring Black on Habanero Yellow pill. Headline: 'Choose Your Heat Level' in Boogaloo at 64px, Smoke Ring Black, sentence case. No subheadline. The header sits on the Lava Cream page background with 64px top padding and 40px bottom padding before the grid begins.

**Grid layout (desktop ≥1280px):**
Three columns. The grid is staggered: cards in column 2 are offset downward by 40px relative to columns 1 and 3, creating a deliberate vertical rhythm break. Cards are not equal height — they size to their content with a minimum height of 360px. Gap between cards: 24px horizontal, 24px vertical.

**Individual card design — each card is a distinct color entity:**
- **Serrano Verde (Mild):** Card background Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0). Card title 'Serrano Verde' in Boogaloo at 38px, Lava Cream. Description in Nunito 16px, Lava Cream, regular 400. Metadata tags (Heat Level, Base, Best On) rendered as small pill labels in Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) with Smoke Ring Black text, Permanent Marker at 11px. Card has a thick 4px Smoke Ring Black border and a hard 6px offset box-shadow in Smoke Ring Black (Memphis flat shadow, no blur). Flame emoji badge for heat level rendered large (28px) in the top-right corner of the card.
- **Smoky Diablo (Medium):** Card background Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209). Title in Habanero Yellow. Description in Lava Cream. Metadata pills in Molten Coral with Lava Cream text. Same border and hard shadow treatment.
- **Mango Inferno (Hot):** Card background Habanero Yellow (#FFD600). Title in Smoke Ring Black. Description in Smoke Ring Black. Metadata pills in Molten Coral with Lava Cream text.
- **Pineapple Fury (Hot):** Card background Confetti Pink (#FF85A1). Title in Smoke Ring Black. Description in Smoke Ring Black. Metadata pills in Ghost Pepper Purple with Lava Cream text.
- **Ghost Town (Extra Hot):** Card background Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE). Title in Habanero Yellow. Description in Lava Cream. Metadata pills in Jalapeño Teal with Lava Cream text.
- **Carolina Reaper's Edge (Extreme):** Card background Molten Coral (#FF4D38). Title in Lava Cream. Description in Lava Cream. Metadata pills in Smoke Ring Black with Habanero Yellow text. This card is slightly wider than its column peers — it spans approximately 1.15 column widths, overlapping the gutter slightly, to signal that it's the most extreme entry. On desktop it occupies the bottom-right position.

**Card internal layout:** 32px internal padding on all sides. Card title at top. Below: description text. Below: a thin 2px Smoke Ring Black horizontal rule. Below: the three metadata pill labels (Heat Level, Base, Best On) arranged in a horizontal wrap row.

**Scroll-triggered reveal:** As the grid section enters the viewport, cards animate in staggered — top row (cards 1–3) first, each sliding up 20px and fading in with a half-beat stagger between cards. Bottom row (cards 4–6) follows immediately after the top row begins, with the same stagger. The Carolina Reaper's Edge card gets a very brief extra scale-up (from 0.95 to 1.0) to emphasize its 'extreme' status.

**Hover affordance:** On hover, each card lifts 6px (translateY -6px) and the hard box-shadow deepens to 10px offset. The card's background color lightens slightly via a 10% white semi-transparent overlay. Transition is quick — approximately 180ms ease-out.

**CTA below the grid:** 'Find a Stockist' — a single CTA button, left-aligned (not centered), 40px below the last card row. Boogaloo at 18px, all-caps. Molten Coral background, Lava Cream text, 4px Smoke Ring Black border, 4px hard offset shadow. On hover: Ghost Pepper Purple background, Lava Cream text, same border and shadow.

**Tablet (768–1279px):** Two-column grid, stagger maintained. Carolina Reaper's Edge spans full width at the bottom.
**Mobile (<768px):** Single-column, full-width cards. Stagger removed. Cards stack vertically with 16px gap.
---

SECTION ID: products-section-3
**Section 3 — Heat Comparison / Signature Moment (products-section-3)**

This is the page's **signature visual and motion moment: 'The Flame Scale Takeover.'** The section breaks the grid containment of the page and lets a single graphic object — the Memphis-illustrated heat scale bar — dominate the entire viewport width.

**Section background:** Lava Cream (#FFF5E1). Top padding 80px, bottom padding 80px. The section feels deliberately airier than Section 2, giving the chart room to breathe and command attention.

**Section header (above the layout split):**
Eyebrow: 'Heat Guide' in Permanent Marker at 13px, Ghost Pepper Purple text on Habanero Yellow pill. Headline: 'Not Sure Where to Start?' in Boogaloo at 64px, Smoke Ring Black, sentence case. Subheadline: 'Here's how our sauces stack up on the Lava Mouth Heat Scale.' in Nunito 18px, semi-bold 600, Smoke Ring Black. All left-aligned. 40px below the subheadline, the layout splits.

**Layout structure — side-tabbed index + chart:**
On desktop, the layout is a two-column asymmetric split: left column is 28% width, right column is 72% width.

**Left column — Heat Tier Index:**
Five heat tier labels stacked vertically. Each label is set in Boogaloo at 36px. The five labels alternate color: tier 1 (🔥 Mild) in Jalapeño Teal; tier 2 (🔥🔥 Medium) in Molten Coral; tier 3 (🔥🔥🔥 Hot) in Jalapeño Teal; tier 4 (🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥 Extra Hot) in Molten Coral; tier 5 (🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥+ Extreme) in Ghost Pepper Purple. Each label has a short description in Nunito 14px, Smoke Ring Black, regular 400, directly below it. Sauce name for each tier in Permanent Marker at 12px, Sauce Bottle Green (#1D7A3A). Vertical spacing between tiers: 32px. The left column is vertically centered relative to the chart height.

**Right column — The Heat Scale Chart (signature visual moment):**
The chart bar is the hero. It is rendered at full right-column width and bleeds an additional 48px beyond the right page margin — intentionally breaking the grid, reaching toward the viewport edge. The bar is approximately 96px tall. It is a horizontal gradient bar from Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) at the far left through Molten Coral (#FF4D38) in the middle to a near-black red (#2A0000 — a deep tone outside the main palette, used only here as a gradient terminus to signal extreme heat) at the far right. The bar has a 4px Smoke Ring Black border and a hard 8px Smoke Ring Black offset box-shadow (Memphis flat shadow). Five flame icons are positioned along the bar at evenly spaced intervals marking each tier node. These flames are bold, flat-color illustrated shapes (not emoji) — approximately 48px tall — in alternating Lava Cream and Habanero Yellow fills with Smoke Ring Black outlines. Each flame sits atop the bar, centered on its node. Directly below each flame node, the sauce name is annotated in Permanent Marker at 13px, Smoke Ring Black, angled slightly (approximately 5° counter-clockwise) to evoke a hand-stamped label.

**Body copy:** The body paragraph ('We rate our sauces on a five-flame scale...') appears below the chart in Nunito 16px, regular 400, Smoke Ring Black, maximum width 640px, left-aligned under the right column. 24px gap below the chart.

**Signature motion — 'The Flame Bar Ignition':**
When this section scrolls into the viewport (IntersectionObserver trigger), the gradient bar animates as if being drawn from left to right — it starts at 0% width and expands to 100% width over approximately 1.2 seconds with an ease-out curve, revealing the gradient as it fills. Each flame icon at the five tier nodes pops in sequentially as the bar's fill reaches that node: each flame scales from 0.5 to 1.1 then settles to 1.0 with a quick bounce (approximately 0.2s per flame, staggered by the bar's fill timing). The tier labels on the left index column slide in from 16px left of their resting position, staggered one per 0.15s, beginning simultaneously with the bar animation. The sauce name annotations below the bar fade in after their respective flame icon lands.

**Hover affordance on tier rows (left column):** When the user hovers over a tier label in the left index, a 4px Habanero Yellow left border appears on that row, and the corresponding sauce name annotation on the chart bar briefly scales to 1.05 and back (quick 150ms pulse). This creates a linked hover state between the index and the chart.

**Tablet:** Side-tab layout collapses to stacked — index above chart. Chart width becomes full column width (no bleed). **Mobile:** Chart scales to full viewport width minus 32px margin. Tier index stacks as a scrollable vertical list above the chart. Flame icons scale to 32px.
---

SECTION ID: products-section-4
**Section 4 — Testimonials (products-section-4)**

This section is a full-bleed Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) panel — a strong, saturated color block that creates a dramatic relief from the Lava Cream sections above and below. The panel runs edge-to-edge, no border-radius, no margin. Top and bottom padding: 80px on desktop, 56px on tablet/mobile.

**Section header:**
Eyebrow: 'The People Have Spoken' in Permanent Marker at 13px, Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) text on a Molten Coral pill background. Centered above the testimonial layout. Headline: 'Hot Takes From Real Mouths' in Boogaloo at 64px, Lava Cream (#FFF5E1), centered. 32px below the headline, the testimonial layout begins.

**Testimonial layout — off-axis staggered, NOT identical columns:**
Three testimonials are arranged in an asymmetric horizontal layout on desktop. They are not equal-width identical cards. Instead:
- **Left testimonial (Priya K.):** Positioned at normal baseline. Card width approximately 36% of the content area. Card background: a slightly lighter purple tint (Ghost Pepper Purple at 80% — achieved via a semi-transparent Lava Cream overlay at 8% on the panel). No card border — the distinction is subtle, giving a layered feel.
- **Center testimonial (Marcus D.):** Offset upward by 28px relative to the left and right cards. Card width approximately 38%. This is the 'featured' quote — it gets the most visual prominence through its upward offset and slightly larger quote text (Nunito 19px vs 17px for the others).
- **Right testimonial (Jess T.):** Positioned at normal baseline. Card width approximately 34%. Slightly narrower, creating asymmetry.

**Card interior design:**
Each card has 32px internal padding. A large decorative opening quotation mark in Boogaloo at 72px, Habanero Yellow, sits at the top-left of the card — purely decorative, not part of the text flow. Quote body text in Nunito 17px (19px for center card), regular 400, Lava Cream, line-height 1.7. Attribution line (name and city) in Permanent Marker at 12px, Habanero Yellow, loose letter-spacing. Sauce metadata (e.g., 'Sauce: Mango Inferno') in Nunito 13px, Confetti Pink (#FF85A1), below the attribution.

**Decorative Memphis elements:**
Confetti Pink squiggles and small abstract dot clusters are scattered across the purple panel background — positioned in the top-left corner, bottom-right corner, and between the center and right cards. These are not tucked into corners as afterthoughts — the squiggle in the top-left is large (approximately 120px wide) and overlaps the panel edge. The dots between cards are a loose cluster of 8–12 circles at 8–16px diameter. Molten Coral small triangle shapes (Memphis confetti) are scattered in 4–5 instances across the panel. All decorative shapes are rendered at low z-index, behind the card content but above the panel background.

**Scroll-triggered reveal:** The purple panel fades in as a block when it enters the viewport. The three testimonial cards then slide up 20px and fade in in sequence — left card first, center card a beat later, right card a beat after that.

**Hover affordance:** On hover, each card's background lightens from the subtle tint to a slightly more visible Lava Cream overlay (12% opacity), and the attribution text shifts from Habanero Yellow to Lava Cream. Transition approximately 200ms ease.

**No CTA in this section** — the section is a moment of social warmth and human connection, not a conversion push. The deliberate absence of a button here gives the testimonials room to breathe.

**Tablet:** Three cards stack vertically, each full-width. Vertical offsets removed. **Mobile:** Same as tablet, 24px gap between cards.
---

SECTION ID: products-section-5
**Section 5 — CTA Close (products-section-5)**

This is a short, punchy, full-bleed Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) panel — a final burst of energy before the footer. The section runs edge-to-edge with no border-radius. Top padding: 72px. Bottom padding: 72px. The panel is intentionally brief — maximum four lines of text and two buttons. The energy is fun urgency.

**Confetti shapes — structural decoration, not corner garnish:**
Before any text, confetti shapes are placed overlapping the top and bottom edges of the panel, crossing the boundary between this section and the sections above and below. Top edge: three Ghost Pepper Purple abstract Memphis shapes (a thick zigzag, a filled circle, a parallelogram) at 48–80px scale, overlapping the panel top edge by 20–30px, partially covering the transition from Section 4. Bottom edge: two Jalapeño Teal shapes (a triangle and a rounded square) overlapping the panel bottom edge. These shapes are positioned at z-index above the panel background but below the text content. They are not symmetrically placed — the top-left has two shapes, the top-right has one; the bottom-left has one, the bottom-right has one. This asymmetry is intentional and Memphis-authentic.

**Ambient motion on confetti shapes:** Each confetti shape floats gently — a slow sine-wave vertical drift (up 6px and back down) on independent cycles ranging from 3 to 5 seconds, each shape starting at a different phase of the cycle. This gives the CTA panel a celebratory, lively energy without being distracting.

**Content layout:** Left-aligned, not centered. Content occupies the left 60% of the panel on desktop.

**Eyebrow:** 'Ready to Commit?' in Permanent Marker at 14px, Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) text on a Molten Coral pill background. 8px vertical padding, 16px horizontal padding.

**Headline:** 'YOUR KITCHEN NEEDS THIS' in Boogaloo at 88px, all-caps, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209). This is the second-largest type on the page and the loudest moment of the CTA. The headline is left-aligned and intentionally oversized — it may break to two lines at tablet width, which is acceptable and even desirable. Zero tracking.

**Subheadline:** 'Find Lava Mouth at a store near you or ask your favorite local shop to carry us.' in Nunito 18px, semi-bold 600, Smoke Ring Black. Maximum width 480px. 16px below the headline.

**CTA buttons (two, horizontal row, 32px gap):**
- Primary: 'Find a Stockist' — Boogaloo 18px, all-caps, Molten Coral (#FF4D38) background, Lava Cream text, 4px Smoke Ring Black border, 4px hard Smoke Ring Black offset box-shadow (Memphis flat shadow). Padding: 16px vertical, 32px horizontal.
- Secondary: 'Contact Us' — Boogaloo 18px, all-caps, Smoke Ring Black background, Lava Cream text, 4px Smoke Ring Black border, 4px hard Smoke Ring Black offset shadow.
- On hover, primary button lifts 4px (translateY -4px), shadow deepens to 8px offset. On hover, secondary button inverts to Lava Cream background with Smoke Ring Black text.

**Scroll-triggered reveal:** As the panel enters the viewport, the confetti shapes scale in from 0 to 1 (quick pop, approximately 0.25s each, staggered). The eyebrow pill, headline, subheadline, and buttons then fade and slide up in sequence — eyebrow first, headline a beat later, subheadline and buttons together a beat after that.

**Tablet (768–1279px):** Layout remains left-aligned. Headline scales to 64px. Confetti shapes reduce to 3 total (2 top, 1 bottom). **Mobile (<768px):** Content becomes full-width. Headline scales to 48px. Buttons stack vertically with 12px gap. Confetti shapes reduce to 2 (1 top-right, 1 bottom-left) to avoid clutter.

1	PAGE INSTR:
2	## Our Story — Page-Level Design Direction
3	
4	### Page Role & Emotional Arc
5	This is the editorial heart of the Lava Mouth site. Where the Home page arrives with a shout, the Story page earns its place by slowing down just enough to feel human — then building back to a warm, confident close. The scroll should feel like reading a great short story: deliberate pacing, a few genuine surprises, and a payoff that makes you want to buy the sauce. Every section has a distinct skeleton; no two layouts repeat the same structure.
6	
7	### Section Sequence & Rhythm
8	1. **Page Header** — Cinematic, near-full-viewport stillness. Dense typographic moment. Sparse layout, maximum weight.
9	2. **Story Block (Founding)** — Warm editorial prose with a large Memphis illustration dominating the left half. The first human, slow-down moment.
10	3. **Timeline** — The page's highest-energy structural section. Alternating teal and yellow color blocks, bold oversized year numerals, zigzag milestone rhythm. Kinetic and celebratory.
11	4. **Story Block (Philosophy)** — A manifesto-style section built around a bold pull-quote typographic stunt and an illustrated sourcing map. Confident and grounded.
12	5. **CTA Close** — Ghost Pepper Purple full-bleed panel. Warm, personal, handshake energy. Centered composition (the one justified exception on this page — the editorial close demands it).
13	
14	### Signature Moment
15	**The Timeline's Oversized Year Numerals as Color-Block Anchors (Section 3).** Each milestone year is rendered in Boogaloo at ~160–180px, all-caps weight, filled with alternating Jalapeño Teal and Habanero Yellow, and bleeds slightly off the left edge of its block — functioning simultaneously as a structural divider, a decorative Memphis graphic element, and the actual content label. The year numeral IS the section header, not a label above it. This move is unmistakably Memphis: bold flat color, oversized type used as shape, and the deliberate off-grid bleed that creates structural tension. It could not exist on a SaaS or heritage page.
16	
17	**Signature Motion Moment:** As each timeline block enters the viewport, its oversized year numeral slides in from the left — starting off-screen, landing with a slight elastic overshoot — while the milestone text fades up a beat later. The alternating teal/yellow blocks themselves scale up from 95% to 100% as they arrive, giving the section a rhythmic, accordion-like energy as the visitor scrolls through the brand's history.
18	
19	### Color & Surface Logic
20	- Section 1 (Header): Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) background. Molten Coral headline fill. Smoke Ring Black body.
21	- Section 2 (Founding Story): Lava Cream surface, large Memphis illustration left. Sauce Bottle Green used on chapter eyebrow pill. Confetti Pink squiggles scattered behind illustration.
22	- Section 3 (Timeline): Full-bleed alternating blocks — Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) and Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) per milestone pair. Year numerals in contrasting palette color (yellow on teal blocks, teal on yellow blocks). Milestone text in Smoke Ring Black.
23	- Section 4 (Philosophy): Lava Cream surface with a Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) pull-quote stripe cutting horizontally across the section. Illustration of the sourcing map placed right. Molten Coral used on the "Flavor First" pull-quote text inside the purple stripe.
24	- Section 5 (CTA): Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) full-bleed panel. Habanero Yellow headline. Lava Cream body text. Molten Coral primary CTA button. Jalapeño Teal secondary CTA button.
25	
26	### Typography Hierarchy
27	- H1 (Page Header): Boogaloo, ~88px, all-caps, Molten Coral fill on Lava Cream — the arrival statement.
28	- H2 (Section Headlines): Boogaloo, 52–60px, sentence case, color varies by section surface.
29	- Pull Quote (Section 4): Boogaloo, ~72px, all-caps, Molten Coral on Ghost Pepper Purple stripe — the typographic stunt.
30	- Eyebrow Labels: Permanent Marker, 12px, loose tracking, in pill shapes — Confetti Pink background on light surfaces, Habanero Yellow on dark.
31	- Body: Nunito, 17px, 1.7 line-height, 65ch measure, Smoke Ring Black on light surfaces, Lava Cream on dark panels.
32	- Timeline Year Numerals: Boogaloo, 160–180px, alternating Habanero Yellow / Jalapeño Teal fills.
33	- Timeline Milestone Titles: Boogaloo, 28px, Smoke Ring Black.
34	- Timeline Descriptions: Nunito, 16px, semi-bold 600, Smoke Ring Black.
35	
36	### Density & Whitespace Logic
37	The page breathes through deliberate contrast: the header and philosophy sections are sparse and editorial (generous vertical padding, restrained element count); the timeline section is intentionally dense and energetic (tight stacking, bold color blocks, maximum graphic weight). This alternating dense/sparse rhythm mirrors the storytelling scroll structure — tension and release, just like a good story.
38	
39	### Motion Design
40	
41	**On-Load Arc (Page Header):**
42	- The Lava Cream background arrives instantly.
43	- The eyebrow pill fades in and drops down from 12px above its resting position.
44	- A beat later, the H1 headline ("It Started With a Pepper Plant and a Dare") reveals word by word, each word sliding up from 20px below with a quick, snappy ease — the Molten Coral fill appearing as each word lands.
45	- The subheadline fades in as a unit a beat after the last headline word settles.
46	- Three small Confetti Pink Memphis squiggle shapes drift in from off-screen corners — one from top-left, one from bottom-right, one from the right edge — each on a slight delay, landing gently behind the text stack.
47	
48	**Scroll-Triggered Reveals:**
49	- Section 2 (Founding Story): The illustration slides in from the left while the editorial text block fades up from below. The two motions are slightly offset — illustration arrives first, text follows a beat later — so the image "sets the scene" before the words appear.
50	- Section 3 (Timeline): Each milestone block triggers individually as it enters the viewport. The oversized year numeral slides in from the left with an elastic overshoot (the signature motion moment). The milestone title and description fade up a beat after the numeral lands. Blocks alternate left-to-right entry direction to match the zigzag layout rhythm.
51	- Section 4 (Philosophy): The Ghost Pepper Purple pull-quote stripe wipes in from left to right — like a highlighter stroke — before the quote text fades in on top of it. The sourcing map illustration scales up from 97% to 100% as it enters, with a gentle fade.
52	- Section 5 (CTA Close): The entire panel fades in and scales from 98% to 100% as it enters. The two CTA buttons stagger in — primary first, secondary a beat later.
53	
54	**Hover & Focus Affordances:**
55	- CTA Buttons (Section 5): Primary Molten Coral button lifts 3px, shadow deepens, and the label shifts to Smoke Ring Black on hover. Secondary Jalapeño Teal button gets a 2px Habanero Yellow border highlight and slight lift.
56	- Timeline milestone blocks: A subtle 2px Molten Coral left border appears on hover, and the milestone title shifts from Smoke Ring Black to Molten Coral.
57	- All interactive elements receive a visible focus ring in Habanero Yellow for keyboard navigation.
58	
59	**Ambient Looped Motion:**
60	- The three Confetti Pink squiggle decorations in the page header drift very slowly — a gentle, looping float animation (up 6px, back, up 6px) on a ~4-second cycle, each offset so they never move in unison. This gives the header a living, breathing quality without distracting from the headline.
61	- In Section 3, a thin Confetti Pink dot-pattern strip runs horizontally between the timeline and the section header — this strip slowly scrolls left at a very gentle pace (marquee-style, nearly imperceptible) to suggest forward momentum through the brand's history.
62	
63	**Signature Motion Moment (named):** "The Year Numeral Slam-In" — as each timeline block enters the viewport, its oversized year numeral (160–180px Boogaloo) launches in from the left edge of the screen, decelerating sharply and overshooting its final position by ~8px before snapping back. The effect feels like a rubber stamp being pressed onto the page — bold, physical, irreverent. This is the kinetic expression of the Memphis aesthetic: type as graphic object, motion as personality.
64	
65	### Responsive Behavior
66	- **Desktop (1280px+):** Timeline uses a two-column zigzag layout — odd milestones left-aligned, even milestones right-aligned, with the year numeral bleeding off the outer edge. Story blocks use a 55/45 asymmetric split (illustration / text). Pull-quote stripe spans full content width.
67	- **Tablet (768–1279px):** Timeline collapses to a single left-aligned column with year numerals at 110px. Story block splits become 50/50 stacked if needed, illustration above text. Pull-quote stripe remains full-width.
68	- **Mobile (below 768px):** All sections stack vertically. Year numerals reduce to 80px but retain their color fills. Illustrations stack above their text blocks. Full-bleed color panels (timeline, CTA) extend edge-to-edge. Typography scales down gracefully — H1 to ~52px, H2 to ~38px, pull quote to ~44px.
69	
70	### Fit Within Shared Design System
71	This page uses the full palette expressively — Jalapeño Teal and Habanero Yellow dominate the timeline (their designated "alternating color blocks" usage), Ghost Pepper Purple anchors the philosophy pull-quote and CTA close (its designated "testimonial section panels" usage), and Molten Coral carries the hero headline and pull-quote text (its designated "hero headline fills" usage). Boogaloo, Nunito, and Permanent Marker are all deployed at their specified scales. The Memphis visual cues — abstract squiggles, confetti shapes, bright blocks, patterned backgrounds — are structural devices here, not afterthoughts. This page is the most editorial on the site, but it never forgets it belongs to a loud, joyful, irreverent hot sauce brand.
72	===
73	
74	SECTION ID: story-section-1
75	**Section 1 — Page Header: 'It Started With a Pepper Plant and a Dare'**
76	
77	This section opens the story page with deliberate, cinematic stillness — a near-full-viewport moment of editorial weight that signals to the visitor that this page is different from the rest of the site. It should feel like the opening page of a book: slow, purposeful, worth reading.
78	
79	**Layout & Grid:** Full-viewport-height (100vh) panel on desktop, 85vh on tablet, auto-height with generous padding (120px top/bottom) on mobile. Content is left-aligned within a centered content column (max-width 900px), positioned in the lower-left quadrant of the viewport — not centered, not split. The text stack sits at roughly the 55% vertical mark, leaving generous breathing room above. This asymmetric vertical placement creates editorial tension and avoids the standard hero-center composition.
80	
81	**Background & Surface:** Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) full-bleed background. No image, no pattern fill — the surface is intentionally bare to create contrast with the rest of the site's energy. Three Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) Memphis squiggle shapes are scattered across the background: one large squiggle in the upper-right corner (partially clipped by the viewport edge), one medium squiggle in the lower-left behind the text stack, and one small squiggle floating near the top-center. These are decorative SVG shapes — abstract, rounded, Memphis-style — rendered at low opacity (roughly 35%) so they read as texture rather than foreground elements. They are NOT tucked into corners as afterthoughts; the upper-right squiggle is large enough (~280px wide) to feel like a structural background element.
82	
83	**Eyebrow Label:** 'The Origin' — Permanent Marker typeface, 12px, loose letter-spacing (~0.08em), Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) text inside a Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) pill-shaped background (16px horizontal padding, 6px vertical padding, fully rounded corners). Positioned left-aligned, 24px above the headline.
84	
85	**Headline:** 'It Started With a Pepper Plant and a Dare' — Boogaloo typeface, 88px on desktop (scaling to 52px on mobile), sentence case (NOT all-caps — this is a story opening, not a battle cry), Molten Coral (#FF4D38) fill, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) text-shadow or outline stroke at 2px for depth and legibility on the cream background. Line-height 1.1. The headline wraps across 2–3 lines naturally at desktop width. Slight negative tracking (-0.01em).
86	
87	**Subheadline:** 'The honest, slightly embarrassing story of how Lava Mouth went from a backyard garden to a bottle on your shelf.' — Nunito, 18px, regular 400 weight, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), 1.65 line-height, max-width 560px, left-aligned. Positioned 28px below the headline.
88	
89	**No CTAs in this section.** The section closes without a button — the visitor is meant to scroll, not click. A subtle downward scroll indicator (a small animated arrow or chevron in Jalapeño Teal, gently bouncing on a 2-second loop) sits 40px below the subheadline to invite the scroll.
90	
91	**Bottom Edge:** A thin (4px) Molten Coral horizontal rule spans the full content column width, positioned 48px below the subheadline, acting as a section close and story-start marker.
92	
93	**Motion:** On page load, the eyebrow pill fades in and drops 12px into place (quick, ~0.25s). A beat later, the headline reveals word by word — each word slides up from 20px below its resting position with a snappy ease, the Molten Coral fill appearing as each word lands. The subheadline fades in as a unit a beat after the last headline word settles (~0.3s fade). The three Confetti Pink squiggles drift in from their respective off-screen edges — upper-right squiggle slides in from the right, lower-left squiggle from the left, top-center squiggle fades in from above — each on a slight stagger so they don't arrive simultaneously. After load, the squiggles enter a slow ambient float loop (up 6px and back, ~4-second cycle, each offset by ~1.3 seconds so they never move in unison). The scroll indicator chevron begins its gentle bounce loop after all content has settled. This section is otherwise still — no parallax, no background animation.
94	---
95	
96	SECTION ID: story-section-2
97	**Section 2 — Story Block: 'A Garden, a Blender, and a Very Unhappy Neighbor'**
98	
99	This is the founding story section — the first human moment on the page. It should feel like the founder talking directly to you. Warm, funny, a little scrappy. The layout prioritizes readability and the illustration's narrative power.
100	
101	**Layout & Grid:** Asymmetric two-column split on desktop — illustration occupies the LEFT 55% of the content area, editorial text occupies the RIGHT 45%. The illustration is NOT a polite inset; it is large, dominant, and bleeds slightly above and below the section's content bounds (overlapping into the section padding zone by ~40px top and bottom) to create the sense that it's bursting out of its container. On tablet, the columns become 50/50. On mobile, illustration stacks above text.
102	
103	**Background & Surface:** Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) background, consistent with the header. Section padding: 96px top, 80px bottom on desktop.
104	
105	**Eyebrow Label:** 'Chapter One' — Permanent Marker, 12px, loose tracking, Sauce Bottle Green (#1D7A3A) text inside a Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) pill. Left-aligned above the headline in the text column.
106	
107	**Headline:** 'A Garden, a Blender, and a Very Unhappy Neighbor' — Boogaloo, 52px on desktop (38px on mobile), sentence case, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) fill. Left-aligned in the text column. Line-height 1.15. Positioned 16px below the eyebrow.
108	
109	**Body Text:** The three-paragraph founding story — Nunito, 17px, regular 400 weight, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), 1.72 line-height, max-width 480px in the text column. Paragraphs separated by 20px gap. The second paragraph ('Lava Mouth wasn't planned...') is set in Nunito semi-bold 600 to give it slightly more weight — it's the emotional core of the founding story. The third paragraph (the nephew/lava mouth origin) returns to regular 400.
110	
111	**Illustration Placement (LEFT side):** The Memphis-style illustrated scene of the community garden plot (asset: story-section-2-asset-1) fills the left column. It is rendered large — approximately 520px wide on desktop — and sits vertically centered relative to the text column, with the top edge bleeding ~40px above the section's top padding boundary and the bottom edge bleeding ~40px below the bottom padding boundary. This overflow bleed is intentional: it makes the illustration feel alive and uncontained, consistent with Memphis energy. Behind the illustration (in the section background layer), a cluster of small Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) dot shapes (confetti scatter pattern, ~8–12 dots at varying sizes 6–16px) are positioned in the upper-left quadrant of the illustration zone, adding Memphis texture without obscuring the illustration itself.

113	**No CTAs.** This section ends with the body text. No button, no rule. The story continues by scrolling.

115	**Motion:** As this section enters the viewport (IntersectionObserver trigger), the illustration slides in from the left — starting 40px off its resting position — while simultaneously fading from 0 to full opacity over ~0.5s. The text column (eyebrow, headline, body) fades up from 24px below its resting position, but starts ~0.2s after the illustration begins moving, so the image 'sets the scene' before the words appear. The Confetti Pink dot cluster behind the illustration fades in last, ~0.3s after the text settles. The section is otherwise still — no looped animation.

120	
121	**THIS IS THE PAGE'S SIGNATURE MOMENT.** The timeline section is the highest-energy structural element on the page — a victory lap through the brand's history rendered as a series of bold color-block panels with oversized year numerals that function simultaneously as graphic shapes, structural dividers, and content labels. 125	**Section Header (above the timeline blocks):**
126	- Eyebrow: 'The Journey' — Permanent Marker, 12px, Smoke Ring Black in Confetti Pink pill, left-aligned.
127	- Headline: 'From Mason Jars to Shelves Nationwide' — Boogaloo, 60px, all-caps, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), left-aligned. Positioned 16px below eyebrow. 48px of space between headline and the first timeline block.
128	- Background of the header sub-area: Lava Cream (#FFF5E1), same as surrounding sections.
129	
130	**Color Block Pattern (milestone blocks):**
131	- Milestones 1, 3, 5 (2018, 2020, 2022): Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) background.
132	- Milestones 2, 4, 6 (2019, 2021, 2023–Now): Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) background.
133	- This strict alternation creates the Memphis bright-block energy.
134	
135	**Year Numeral (THE SIGNATURE MOVE):** Each milestone block's year (e.g., '2018', '2019', '2023–') is rendered in Boogaloo at 160–180px on desktop (110px on tablet, 80px on mobile), all-caps weight (Boogaloo has no true all-caps but the display size makes it monumental). Color: Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) numerals on Teal blocks; Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) numerals on Yellow blocks — always the opposite of the block background for maximum contrast. The year numeral is left-aligned within its block and bleeds ~20px off the LEFT edge of the block (slightly beyond the content boundary), creating the off-grid tension that is central to the Memphis aesthetic. The numeral sits at the top of the block, with the milestone title and description stacked below it inside the block's padding zone.
136	
137	**Milestone Title:** Boogaloo, 28px, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), left-aligned, 12px below the numeral baseline.
138	**Milestone Description:** Nunito, 16px, semi-bold 600, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), left-aligned, 8px below the title, max-width 360px.
139	**Block padding:** 32px left (accounting for numeral bleed), 24px right, 28px bottom.
140	
141	**Confetti Pink Dot-Pattern Strip:** The 16px-tall horizontal strip between the section header and the first block is a repeating dot pattern in Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) on Lava Cream — dots at ~6px diameter, 18px spacing. This strip slowly scrolls left at a nearly imperceptible pace (ambient marquee, ~60s for a full cycle) to suggest forward momentum through the brand's history.
142	
143	**Motion (SIGNATURE MOTION MOMENT — 'The Year Numeral Slam-In'):** As each timeline block enters the viewport (IntersectionObserver, triggered individually), its oversized year numeral launches in from the LEFT edge of the screen — starting ~80px off-screen to the left — and decelerates sharply, overshooting its final resting position by ~8px before snapping back with a subtle elastic ease. This feels like a rubber stamp being pressed onto the page: bold, physical, irreverent. The color block itself scales up from 95% to 100% width simultaneously. The milestone title fades up from 12px below its resting position a beat after the numeral lands. The description follows a beat after the title. On desktop with the zigzag layout, left-column blocks enter from the left, right-column blocks enter from the right (mirrored slam-in). The Confetti Pink dot-strip ambient scroll begins on page load and runs continuously. On hover over any milestone block, a 2px Molten Coral left border appears on the block and the milestone title shifts from Smoke Ring Black to Molten Coral — a quick color transition (~0.15s).

146	SECTION ID: story-section-4
147	**Section 4 — Story Block (Philosophy): 'Flavor First. Heat Second. Always Small-Batch.'**
148	
149	This is the brand manifesto section — confident, grounded, and built around a typographic stunt that makes the core philosophy impossible to miss. The layout is asymmetric: a bold pull-quote stripe cuts horizontally through the section, with editorial prose above and below, and the sourcing map illustration anchoring the right half.

151	**Layout & Grid:** On desktop, a two-column asymmetric layout — LEFT column (55%) contains the eyebrow, headline, the Ghost Pepper Purple pull-quote stripe, and the body text; RIGHT column (45%) contains the sourcing map illustration. On tablet, the columns become stacked (text above, illustration below) but the pull-quote stripe remains full-bleed. On mobile, single column, full-width stripe.
152	
153	**Background & Surface:** Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) base. The pull-quote stripe is Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE), 80px tall on desktop (64px on tablet), spanning 100% viewport width. Section padding: 96px top, 80px bottom.
154	
155	**Eyebrow Label:** 'What We Believe' — Permanent Marker, 12px, loose tracking, Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) text inside a Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) pill with a 2px Ghost Pepper Purple border. Left-aligned above the headline in the left column. (Using a bordered pill variant here since the section background is also cream — the border provides definition.)
156	
157	**Headline:** 'Flavor First. Heat Second. Always Small-Batch.' — Boogaloo, 56px on desktop (40px on mobile), sentence case, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), left-aligned. 16px below eyebrow. Line-height 1.15.
158	
159	**Pull-Quote Stripe (THE TYPOGRAPHIC STUNT):** The full-bleed Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) horizontal stripe contains a single line of text centered vertically within it: 'FLAVOR FIRST. ALWAYS.' — Boogaloo, 72px on desktop (48px on tablet, 32px on mobile), all-caps, Molten Coral (#FF4D38) fill, centered horizontally within the stripe. The text is large enough that it nearly fills the stripe height, creating a type-as-image moment. Two small Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) Memphis triangle shapes (solid, ~24px) flank the text on each side as decorative punctuation within the stripe. 161	**Body Text (below the stripe, left column):** The three-paragraph philosophy text — Nunito, 17px, regular 400 weight, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), 1.72 line-height, max-width 480px. First paragraph starts 32px below the bottom edge of the stripe. Paragraph 2 ('Small-batch isn't a marketing phrase...') is set in Nunito semi-bold 600 — it contains the brand's core promise and deserves slightly more weight. Paragraph 3 (sourcing/farms) returns to regular 400.
162	
163	**Illustration Placement (RIGHT column):** The Memphis-style sourcing map illustration (asset: story-section-4-asset-1) fills the right column. 170	
171	This is the warm, personal handshake at the end of a great conversation. The energy is confident and inviting — not a hard sell, but a natural next step. The one justified centered composition on this page: the editorial close demands symmetry and finality.
172	
173	**Layout & Grid:** Full-bleed Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) panel. All content centered horizontally. Generous padding: 120px top and bottom on desktop (80px on tablet, 64px on mobile). Content max-width 640px, centered.
174	
175	**Background & Surface:** Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) full-bleed, edge-to-edge, no border radius. 176	
177	**Eyebrow Label:** 'Now You Know Us' — Permanent Marker, 12px, loose tracking, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) text inside a Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) pill. Centered above the headline. 0px margin-bottom before headline.

179	**Headline:** 'Come Find Your Sauce' — Boogaloo, 80px on desktop (52px on mobile), all-caps, Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) fill. Centered. Line-height 1.05. Slight negative tracking (-0.015em). Positioned 20px below the eyebrow pill.
180

184	- Primary: 'Shop the Lineup' — Molten Coral (#FF4D38) background, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) label text, Boogaloo 20px, all-caps, 24px horizontal padding, 14px vertical padding, 0 border-radius (sharp corners — Memphis flat-block aesthetic, NOT rounded pill).
