PAGE INSTR:
## Our Story — Page-Level Design Direction

### Page Role & Emotional Arc
This is the editorial heart of the Lava Mouth site. Where the Home page arrives with a shout, the Story page earns its place by slowing down just enough to feel human — then building back to a warm, confident close. The scroll should feel like reading a great short story: deliberate pacing, a few genuine surprises, and a payoff that makes you want to buy the sauce. Every section has a distinct skeleton; no two layouts repeat the same structure.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
1. **Page Header** — Cinematic, near-full-viewport stillness. Dense typographic moment. Sparse layout, maximum weight.
2. **Story Block (Founding)** — Warm editorial prose with a large Memphis illustration dominating the left half. The first human, slow-down moment.
3. **Timeline** — The page's highest-energy structural section. Alternating teal and yellow color blocks, bold oversized year numerals, zigzag milestone rhythm. Kinetic and celebratory.
4. **Story Block (Philosophy)** — A manifesto-style section built around a bold pull-quote typographic stunt and an illustrated sourcing map. Confident and grounded.
5. **CTA Close** — Ghost Pepper Purple full-bleed panel. Warm, personal, handshake energy. Centered composition (the one justified exception on this page — the editorial close demands it).

### Signature Moment
**The Timeline's Oversized Year Numerals as Color-Block Anchors (Section 3).** Each milestone year is rendered in Boogaloo at ~160–180px, all-caps weight, filled with alternating Jalapeño Teal and Habanero Yellow, and bleeds slightly off the left edge of its block — functioning simultaneously as a structural divider, a decorative Memphis graphic element, and the actual content label. The year numeral IS the section header, not a label above it. This move is unmistakably Memphis: bold flat color, oversized type used as shape, and the deliberate off-grid bleed that creates structural tension. It could not exist on a SaaS or heritage page.

**Signature Motion Moment:** As each timeline block enters the viewport, its oversized year numeral slides in from the left — starting off-screen, landing with a slight elastic overshoot — while the milestone text fades up a beat later. The alternating teal/yellow blocks themselves scale up from 95% to 100% as they arrive, giving the section a rhythmic, accordion-like energy as the visitor scrolls through the brand's history.

### Color & Surface Logic
- Section 1 (Header): Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) background. Molten Coral headline fill. Smoke Ring Black body.
- Section 2 (Founding Story): Lava Cream surface, large Memphis illustration left. Sauce Bottle Green used on chapter eyebrow pill. Confetti Pink squiggles scattered behind illustration.
- Section 3 (Timeline): Full-bleed alternating blocks — Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) and Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) per milestone pair. Year numerals in contrasting palette color (yellow on teal blocks, teal on yellow blocks). Milestone text in Smoke Ring Black.
- Section 4 (Philosophy): Lava Cream surface with a Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) pull-quote stripe cutting horizontally across the section. Illustration of the sourcing map placed right. Molten Coral used on the "Flavor First" pull-quote text inside the purple stripe.
- Section 5 (CTA): Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) full-bleed panel. Habanero Yellow headline. Lava Cream body text. Molten Coral primary CTA button. Jalapeño Teal secondary CTA button.

### Typography Hierarchy
- H1 (Page Header): Boogaloo, ~88px, all-caps, Molten Coral fill on Lava Cream — the arrival statement.
- H2 (Section Headlines): Boogaloo, 52–60px, sentence case, color varies by section surface.
- Pull Quote (Section 4): Boogaloo, ~72px, all-caps, Molten Coral on Ghost Pepper Purple stripe — the typographic stunt.
- Eyebrow Labels: Permanent Marker, 12px, loose tracking, in pill shapes — Confetti Pink background on light surfaces, Habanero Yellow on dark.
- Body: Nunito, 17px, 1.7 line-height, 65ch measure, Smoke Ring Black on light surfaces, Lava Cream on dark panels.
- Timeline Year Numerals: Boogaloo, 160–180px, alternating Habanero Yellow / Jalapeño Teal fills.
- Timeline Milestone Titles: Boogaloo, 28px, Smoke Ring Black.
- Timeline Descriptions: Nunito, 16px, semi-bold 600, Smoke Ring Black.

### Density & Whitespace Logic
The page breathes through deliberate contrast: the header and philosophy sections are sparse and editorial (generous vertical padding, restrained element count); the timeline section is intentionally dense and energetic (tight stacking, bold color blocks, maximum graphic weight). This alternating dense/sparse rhythm mirrors the storytelling scroll structure — tension and release, just like a good story.

### Motion Design

**On-Load Arc (Page Header):**
- The Lava Cream background arrives instantly.
- The eyebrow pill fades in and drops down from 12px above its resting position.
- A beat later, the H1 headline ("It Started With a Pepper Plant and a Dare") reveals word by word, each word sliding up from 20px below with a quick, snappy ease — the Molten Coral fill appearing as each word lands.
- The subheadline fades in as a unit a beat after the last headline word settles.
- Three small Confetti Pink Memphis squiggle shapes drift in from off-screen corners — one from top-left, one from bottom-right, one from the right edge — each on a slight delay, landing gently behind the text stack.

**Scroll-Triggered Reveals:**
- Section 2 (Founding Story): The illustration slides in from the left while the editorial text block fades up from below. The two motions are slightly offset — illustration arrives first, text follows a beat later — so the image "sets the scene" before the words appear.
- Section 3 (Timeline): Each milestone block triggers individually as it enters the viewport. The oversized year numeral slides in from the left with an elastic overshoot (the signature motion moment). The milestone title and description fade up a beat after the numeral lands. Blocks alternate left-to-right entry direction to match the zigzag layout rhythm.
- Section 4 (Philosophy): The Ghost Pepper Purple pull-quote stripe wipes in from left to right — like a highlighter stroke — before the quote text fades in on top of it. The sourcing map illustration scales up from 97% to 100% as it enters, with a gentle fade.
- Section 5 (CTA Close): The entire panel fades in and scales from 98% to 100% as it enters. The two CTA buttons stagger in — primary first, secondary a beat later.

**Hover & Focus Affordances:**
- CTA Buttons (Section 5): Primary Molten Coral button lifts 3px, shadow deepens, and the label shifts to Smoke Ring Black on hover. Secondary Jalapeño Teal button gets a 2px Habanero Yellow border highlight and slight lift.
- Timeline milestone blocks: A subtle 2px Molten Coral left border appears on hover, and the milestone title shifts from Smoke Ring Black to Molten Coral.
- All interactive elements receive a visible focus ring in Habanero Yellow for keyboard navigation.

**Ambient Looped Motion:**
- The three Confetti Pink squiggle decorations in the page header drift very slowly — a gentle, looping float animation (up 6px, back, up 6px) on a ~4-second cycle, each offset so they never move in unison. This gives the header a living, breathing quality without distracting from the headline.
- In Section 3, a thin Confetti Pink dot-pattern strip runs horizontally between the timeline and the section header — this strip slowly scrolls left at a very gentle pace (marquee-style, nearly imperceptible) to suggest forward momentum through the brand's history.

**Signature Motion Moment (named):** "The Year Numeral Slam-In" — as each timeline block enters the viewport, its oversized year numeral (160–180px Boogaloo) launches in from the left edge of the screen, decelerating sharply and overshooting its final position by ~8px before snapping back. The effect feels like a rubber stamp being pressed onto the page — bold, physical, irreverent. This is the kinetic expression of the Memphis aesthetic: type as graphic object, motion as personality.

### Responsive Behavior
- **Desktop (1280px+):** Timeline uses a two-column zigzag layout — odd milestones left-aligned, even milestones right-aligned, with the year numeral bleeding off the outer edge. Story blocks use a 55/45 asymmetric split (illustration / text). Pull-quote stripe spans full content width.
- **Tablet (768–1279px):** Timeline collapses to a single left-aligned column with year numerals at 110px. Story block splits become 50/50 stacked if needed, illustration above text. Pull-quote stripe remains full-width.
- **Mobile (below 768px):** All sections stack vertically. Year numerals reduce to 80px but retain their color fills. Illustrations stack above their text blocks. Full-bleed color panels (timeline, CTA) extend edge-to-edge. Typography scales down gracefully — H1 to ~52px, H2 to ~38px, pull quote to ~44px.

### Fit Within Shared Design System
This page uses the full palette expressively — Jalapeño Teal and Habanero Yellow dominate the timeline (their designated "alternating color blocks" usage), Ghost Pepper Purple anchors the philosophy pull-quote and CTA close (its designated "testimonial section panels" usage), and Molten Coral carries the hero headline and pull-quote text (its designated "hero headline fills" usage). Boogaloo, Nunito, and Permanent Marker are all deployed at their specified scales. The Memphis visual cues — abstract squiggles, confetti shapes, bright blocks, patterned backgrounds — are structural devices here, not afterthoughts. This page is the most editorial on the site, but it never forgets it belongs to a loud, joyful, irreverent hot sauce brand.
===

SECTION ID: story-section-1
**Section 1 — Page Header: 'It Started With a Pepper Plant and a Dare'**

This section opens the story page with deliberate, cinematic stillness — a near-full-viewport moment of editorial weight that signals to the visitor that this page is different from the rest of the site. It should feel like the opening page of a book: slow, purposeful, worth reading.

**Layout & Grid:** Full-viewport-height (100vh) panel on desktop, 85vh on tablet, auto-height with generous padding (120px top/bottom) on mobile. Content is left-aligned within a centered content column (max-width 900px), positioned in the lower-left quadrant of the viewport — not centered, not split. The text stack sits at roughly the 55% vertical mark, leaving generous breathing room above. This asymmetric vertical placement creates editorial tension and avoids the standard hero-center composition.

**Background & Surface:** Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) full-bleed background. No image, no pattern fill — the surface is intentionally bare to create contrast with the rest of the site's energy. Three Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) Memphis squiggle shapes are scattered across the background: one large squiggle in the upper-right corner (partially clipped by the viewport edge), one medium squiggle in the lower-left behind the text stack, and one small squiggle floating near the top-center. These are decorative SVG shapes — abstract, rounded, Memphis-style — rendered at low opacity (roughly 35%) so they read as texture rather than foreground elements. They are NOT tucked into corners as afterthoughts; the upper-right squiggle is large enough (~280px wide) to feel like a structural background element.

**Eyebrow Label:** 'The Origin' — Permanent Marker typeface, 12px, loose letter-spacing (~0.08em), Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) text inside a Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) pill-shaped background (16px horizontal padding, 6px vertical padding, fully rounded corners). Positioned left-aligned, 24px above the headline.

**Headline:** 'It Started With a Pepper Plant and a Dare' — Boogaloo typeface, 88px on desktop (scaling to 52px on mobile), sentence case (NOT all-caps — this is a story opening, not a battle cry), Molten Coral (#FF4D38) fill, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) text-shadow or outline stroke at 2px for depth and legibility on the cream background. Line-height 1.1. The headline wraps across 2–3 lines naturally at desktop width. Slight negative tracking (-0.01em).

**Subheadline:** 'The honest, slightly embarrassing story of how Lava Mouth went from a backyard garden to a bottle on your shelf.' — Nunito, 18px, regular 400 weight, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), 1.65 line-height, max-width 560px, left-aligned. Positioned 28px below the headline.

**No CTAs in this section.** The section closes without a button — the visitor is meant to scroll, not click. A subtle downward scroll indicator (a small animated arrow or chevron in Jalapeño Teal, gently bouncing on a 2-second loop) sits 40px below the subheadline to invite the scroll.

**Bottom Edge:** A thin (4px) Molten Coral horizontal rule spans the full content column width, positioned 48px below the subheadline, acting as a section close and story-start marker.

**Motion:** On page load, the eyebrow pill fades in and drops 12px into place (quick, ~0.25s). A beat later, the headline reveals word by word — each word slides up from 20px below its resting position with a snappy ease, the Molten Coral fill appearing as each word lands. The subheadline fades in as a unit a beat after the last headline word settles (~0.3s fade). The three Confetti Pink squiggles drift in from their respective off-screen edges — upper-right squiggle slides in from the right, lower-left squiggle from the left, top-center squiggle fades in from above — each on a slight stagger so they don't arrive simultaneously. After load, the squiggles enter a slow ambient float loop (up 6px and back, ~4-second cycle, each offset by ~1.3 seconds so they never move in unison). The scroll indicator chevron begins its gentle bounce loop after all content has settled. This section is otherwise still — no parallax, no background animation.
---

SECTION ID: story-section-2
**Section 2 — Story Block: 'A Garden, a Blender, and a Very Unhappy Neighbor'**

This is the founding story section — the first human moment on the page. It should feel like the founder talking directly to you. Warm, funny, a little scrappy. The layout prioritizes readability and the illustration's narrative power.

**Layout & Grid:** Asymmetric two-column split on desktop — illustration occupies the LEFT 55% of the content area, editorial text occupies the RIGHT 45%. The illustration is NOT a polite inset; it is large, dominant, and bleeds slightly above and below the section's content bounds (overlapping into the section padding zone by ~40px top and bottom) to create the sense that it's bursting out of its container. On tablet, the columns become 50/50. On mobile, illustration stacks above text.

**Background & Surface:** Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) background, consistent with the header. Section padding: 96px top, 80px bottom on desktop.

**Eyebrow Label:** 'Chapter One' — Permanent Marker, 12px, loose tracking, Sauce Bottle Green (#1D7A3A) text inside a Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) pill. Left-aligned above the headline in the text column.

**Headline:** 'A Garden, a Blender, and a Very Unhappy Neighbor' — Boogaloo, 52px on desktop (38px on mobile), sentence case, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) fill. Left-aligned in the text column. Line-height 1.15. Positioned 16px below the eyebrow.

**Body Text:** The three-paragraph founding story — Nunito, 17px, regular 400 weight, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), 1.72 line-height, max-width 480px in the text column. Paragraphs separated by 20px gap. The second paragraph ('Lava Mouth wasn't planned...') is set in Nunito semi-bold 600 to give it slightly more weight — it's the emotional core of the founding story. The third paragraph (the nephew/lava mouth origin) returns to regular 400.

**Illustration Placement (LEFT side):** The Memphis-style illustrated scene of the community garden plot (asset: story-section-2-asset-1) fills the left column. It is rendered large — approximately 520px wide on desktop — and sits vertically centered relative to the text column, with the top edge bleeding ~40px above the section's top padding boundary and the bottom edge bleeding ~40px below the bottom padding boundary. This overflow bleed is intentional: it makes the illustration feel alive and uncontained, consistent with Memphis energy. Behind the illustration (in the section background layer), a cluster of small Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) dot shapes (confetti scatter pattern, ~8–12 dots at varying sizes 6–16px) are positioned in the upper-left quadrant of the illustration zone, adding Memphis texture without obscuring the illustration itself.

**No CTAs.** This section ends with the body text. No button, no rule. The story continues by scrolling.

**Motion:** As this section enters the viewport (IntersectionObserver trigger), the illustration slides in from the left — starting 40px off its resting position — while simultaneously fading from 0 to full opacity over ~0.5s. The text column (eyebrow, headline, body) fades up from 24px below its resting position, but starts ~0.2s after the illustration begins moving, so the image 'sets the scene' before the words appear. The Confetti Pink dot cluster behind the illustration fades in last, ~0.3s after the text settles. The section is otherwise still — no looped animation.
---

SECTION ID: story-section-3
**Section 3 — Timeline: 'From Mason Jars to Shelves Nationwide'**

**THIS IS THE PAGE'S SIGNATURE MOMENT.** The timeline section is the highest-energy structural element on the page — a victory lap through the brand's history rendered as a series of bold color-block panels with oversized year numerals that function simultaneously as graphic shapes, structural dividers, and content labels. This section should feel like a celebration.

**Layout & Grid:** On desktop, the six milestone blocks are arranged in a zigzag two-column layout — odd-numbered milestones (2018, 2020, 2022) anchor to the LEFT half of the content area; even-numbered milestones (2019, 2021, 2023–Now) anchor to the RIGHT half. Each block is a full-width color panel within its column half, approximately 480px wide and auto-height (min 200px). The blocks are NOT vertically separated — they stack with zero gap, creating a continuous alternating-color column on each side. A thin Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) dot-pattern strip (16px tall) runs horizontally across the full page width between the section header and the first milestone block. On tablet, the layout collapses to a single centered column, full content width. On mobile, single column, edge-to-edge.

**Section Header (above the timeline blocks):**
- Eyebrow: 'The Journey' — Permanent Marker, 12px, Smoke Ring Black in Confetti Pink pill, left-aligned.
- Headline: 'From Mason Jars to Shelves Nationwide' — Boogaloo, 60px, all-caps, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), left-aligned. Positioned 16px below eyebrow. 48px of space between headline and the first timeline block.
- Background of the header sub-area: Lava Cream (#FFF5E1), same as surrounding sections.

**Color Block Pattern (milestone blocks):**
- Milestones 1, 3, 5 (2018, 2020, 2022): Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) background.
- Milestones 2, 4, 6 (2019, 2021, 2023–Now): Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) background.
- This strict alternation creates the Memphis bright-block energy.

**Year Numeral (THE SIGNATURE MOVE):** Each milestone block's year (e.g., '2018', '2019', '2023–') is rendered in Boogaloo at 160–180px on desktop (110px on tablet, 80px on mobile), all-caps weight (Boogaloo has no true all-caps but the display size makes it monumental). Color: Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) numerals on Teal blocks; Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) numerals on Yellow blocks — always the opposite of the block background for maximum contrast. The year numeral is left-aligned within its block and bleeds ~20px off the LEFT edge of the block (slightly beyond the content boundary), creating the off-grid tension that is central to the Memphis aesthetic. The numeral sits at the top of the block, with the milestone title and description stacked below it inside the block's padding zone.

**Milestone Title:** Boogaloo, 28px, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), left-aligned, 12px below the numeral baseline.
**Milestone Description:** Nunito, 16px, semi-bold 600, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), left-aligned, 8px below the title, max-width 360px.
**Block padding:** 32px left (accounting for numeral bleed), 24px right, 28px bottom.

**Confetti Pink Dot-Pattern Strip:** The 16px-tall horizontal strip between the section header and the first block is a repeating dot pattern in Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) on Lava Cream — dots at ~6px diameter, 18px spacing. This strip slowly scrolls left at a nearly imperceptible pace (ambient marquee, ~60s for a full cycle) to suggest forward momentum through the brand's history.

**Motion (SIGNATURE MOTION MOMENT — 'The Year Numeral Slam-In'):** As each timeline block enters the viewport (IntersectionObserver, triggered individually), its oversized year numeral launches in from the LEFT edge of the screen — starting ~80px off-screen to the left — and decelerates sharply, overshooting its final resting position by ~8px before snapping back with a subtle elastic ease. This feels like a rubber stamp being pressed onto the page: bold, physical, irreverent. The color block itself scales up from 95% to 100% width simultaneously. The milestone title fades up from 12px below its resting position a beat after the numeral lands. The description follows a beat after the title. On desktop with the zigzag layout, left-column blocks enter from the left, right-column blocks enter from the right (mirrored slam-in). The Confetti Pink dot-strip ambient scroll begins on page load and runs continuously. On hover over any milestone block, a 2px Molten Coral left border appears on the block and the milestone title shifts from Smoke Ring Black to Molten Coral — a quick color transition (~0.15s).
---

SECTION ID: story-section-4
**Section 4 — Story Block (Philosophy): 'Flavor First. Heat Second. Always Small-Batch.'**

This is the brand manifesto section — confident, grounded, and built around a typographic stunt that makes the core philosophy impossible to miss. The layout is asymmetric: a bold pull-quote stripe cuts horizontally through the section, with editorial prose above and below, and the sourcing map illustration anchoring the right half.

**Layout & Grid:** On desktop, a two-column asymmetric layout — LEFT column (55%) contains the eyebrow, headline, the Ghost Pepper Purple pull-quote stripe, and the body text; RIGHT column (45%) contains the sourcing map illustration. The pull-quote stripe is the structural centerpiece: it spans the FULL width of the page (not just the left column) — a full-bleed horizontal band that cuts across both columns at roughly the vertical midpoint of the section, interrupting the layout like a highlighter stroke. On tablet, the columns become stacked (text above, illustration below) but the pull-quote stripe remains full-bleed. On mobile, single column, full-width stripe.

**Background & Surface:** Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) base. The pull-quote stripe is Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE), 80px tall on desktop (64px on tablet), spanning 100% viewport width. Section padding: 96px top, 80px bottom.

**Eyebrow Label:** 'What We Believe' — Permanent Marker, 12px, loose tracking, Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) text inside a Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) pill with a 2px Ghost Pepper Purple border. Left-aligned above the headline in the left column. (Using a bordered pill variant here since the section background is also cream — the border provides definition.)

**Headline:** 'Flavor First. Heat Second. Always Small-Batch.' — Boogaloo, 56px on desktop (40px on mobile), sentence case, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), left-aligned. 16px below eyebrow. Line-height 1.15.

**Pull-Quote Stripe (THE TYPOGRAPHIC STUNT):** The full-bleed Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) horizontal stripe contains a single line of text centered vertically within it: 'FLAVOR FIRST. ALWAYS.' — Boogaloo, 72px on desktop (48px on tablet, 32px on mobile), all-caps, Molten Coral (#FF4D38) fill, centered horizontally within the stripe. The text is large enough that it nearly fills the stripe height, creating a type-as-image moment. Two small Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) Memphis triangle shapes (solid, ~24px) flank the text on each side as decorative punctuation within the stripe. This stripe is positioned 32px below the headline in the left column flow, but because it is full-bleed, it visually 'owns' the entire viewport width at that scroll position.

**Body Text (below the stripe, left column):** The three-paragraph philosophy text — Nunito, 17px, regular 400 weight, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), 1.72 line-height, max-width 480px. First paragraph starts 32px below the bottom edge of the stripe. Paragraph 2 ('Small-batch isn't a marketing phrase...') is set in Nunito semi-bold 600 — it contains the brand's core promise and deserves slightly more weight. Paragraph 3 (sourcing/farms) returns to regular 400.

**Illustration Placement (RIGHT column):** The Memphis-style sourcing map illustration (asset: story-section-4-asset-1) fills the right column. It is approximately 440px wide on desktop, vertically centered relative to the full section height. The illustration sits slightly ABOVE center — its top edge aligns with the headline level — so it feels anchored to the top of the section rather than floating. A Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) rectangular shape (solid, ~16px thick, ~200px wide) is placed behind the bottom-right corner of the illustration, offset by ~12px in both directions, creating a Memphis 'shadow block' effect that gives the illustration a sticker-on-surface quality.

**Motion:** As this section enters the viewport, the Ghost Pepper Purple pull-quote stripe wipes in from LEFT to RIGHT — starting at 0% width and expanding to 100% over ~0.6s with a smooth ease — like a highlighter being drawn across the page. The pull-quote text ('FLAVOR FIRST. ALWAYS.') fades in on top of the stripe once it reaches full width, ~0.1s after the wipe completes. The headline and eyebrow fade up from 16px below their resting positions as the section enters. The sourcing map illustration scales up from 97% to 100% with a simultaneous fade-in as it enters the viewport. The Habanero Yellow shadow block behind the illustration appears ~0.2s after the illustration settles. The section is otherwise still.
---

SECTION ID: story-section-5
**Section 5 — CTA Close: 'Come Find Your Sauce'**

This is the warm, personal handshake at the end of a great conversation. The energy is confident and inviting — not a hard sell, but a natural next step. The one justified centered composition on this page: the editorial close demands symmetry and finality.

**Layout & Grid:** Full-bleed Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) panel. All content centered horizontally. Generous padding: 120px top and bottom on desktop (80px on tablet, 64px on mobile). Content max-width 640px, centered.

**Background & Surface:** Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) full-bleed, edge-to-edge, no border radius. A subtle repeating Memphis pattern is layered into the background at very low opacity (~12%): small abstract squiggle shapes and dot clusters in Confetti Pink (#FF85A1), tiling across the entire panel. This gives the surface texture and depth without competing with the foreground content.

**Eyebrow Label:** 'Now You Know Us' — Permanent Marker, 12px, loose tracking, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) text inside a Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) pill. Centered above the headline. 0px margin-bottom before headline.

**Headline:** 'Come Find Your Sauce' — Boogaloo, 80px on desktop (52px on mobile), all-caps, Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) fill. Centered. Line-height 1.05. Slight negative tracking (-0.015em). Positioned 20px below the eyebrow pill.

**Subheadline:** 'The story's great, but the sauce is better. Go find the one that's yours.' — Nunito, 18px, regular 400 weight, Lava Cream (#FFF5E1), centered, 1.65 line-height, max-width 480px. Positioned 24px below the headline.

**CTA Buttons:** Two buttons, displayed inline on desktop (side by side with 16px gap), stacked on mobile.
- Primary: 'Shop the Lineup' — Molten Coral (#FF4D38) background, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) label text, Boogaloo 20px, all-caps, 24px horizontal padding, 14px vertical padding, 0 border-radius (sharp corners — Memphis flat-block aesthetic, NOT rounded pill). A 3px Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) offset shadow (4px right, 4px down, solid — the Memphis 'sticker' shadow treatment) gives it dimensional weight.
- Secondary: 'Find a Store' — Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) background, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) label text, same sizing and sharp-corner treatment. Same 3px Smoke Ring Black offset shadow.
- Buttons positioned 36px below the subheadline.

**Decorative Element:** Two Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) Memphis star/burst shapes (solid, ~40px) flank the headline — one to the upper-left of the 'C' in 'Come', one to the lower-right of the 'e' in 'Sauce'. These are small, flat, geometric — not photorealistic. They add irreverent Memphis punctuation to the close without cluttering the centered composition.

**Motion:** As this section enters the viewport, the entire Ghost Pepper Purple panel fades in while scaling from 98% to 100% height over ~0.4s — a subtle 'arrival' that gives the close section a sense of weight landing. The eyebrow pill fades in first. The headline follows a beat later with a quick upward slide (16px, ~0.3s). The subheadline fades in a beat after the headline. The two CTA buttons stagger in — primary button appears first, secondary button appears ~0.15s later, each with a quick upward fade. The two Habanero Yellow burst shapes pop in with a quick scale-from-0 animation (like stamps being applied) after the buttons settle.
- **Hover (Primary CTA):** Lifts 3px, offset shadow deepens to 6px, label color shifts to Smoke Ring Black (already black, so background brightens slightly toward a lighter coral). Transition ~0.15s.
- **Hover (Secondary CTA):** Lifts 3px, a 2px Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) border appears around the button, offset shadow deepens. Transition ~0.15s.
- **Focus:** Both buttons receive a 3px Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) focus ring (outline, 2px offset) for keyboard accessibility.
- The section has no looped ambient animation — it is deliberately still after entrance, letting the warm, confident close breathe.
---

1	PAGE INSTR:
2	## Stockists Page — Full Visual Design Direction
3	
4	### Page Role & Emotional Arc
5	This page transforms a utilitarian stockist directory into an exciting discovery experience. The visitor should feel like they're unfolding a treasure map — Lava Mouth is *out there*, alive in the world, in real shops run by real people who believe in it. The scroll moves from geographic spectacle (the map header) → curated directory (regional grid) → editorial warmth (featured partners) → kinetic proof (stats) → open invitation (wholesale CTA). The rhythm deliberately alternates between loud graphic moments and warmer, more editorial pauses, mirroring the storytelling scroll structure.
6	
7	### Signature Moment
8	**The Oversized Illustrated Map Header with Cascading Flame Pins** — Section 1 is the page's defining visual event. A full-bleed, flat-illustrated Memphis-style map of the continental US spans the entire viewport width, rendered in Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) with bold Smoke Ring Black outlines, sitting on a Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) background panel. Molten Coral flame/chili pin markers dot the map at stockist-concentration cities, each pin slightly oversized and cartoonishly bold. The headline "Lava Mouth Is Out in the Wild" is set in Boogaloo at 88px, all-caps, in Molten Coral, crashing over the top-left of the map — not politely above it, but *overlapping* the map surface like a sticker slapped onto the illustration. Confetti Pink squiggles and abstract Memphis triangles and dots are scattered across the teal panel, overlapping both the map edges and the headline. This is unmistakably Memphis: loud, graphic, layered, and joyful. It belongs here because it makes the geographic proof of the brand's reach feel like a celebration rather than a data point.
9	
10	### Signature Motion Moment
11	On page load, the flame/chili map pins *pop in* one by one across the map in a staggered sequence — each pin scales from 0 to 1 with a quick springy overshoot (scale past 1 then settle), starting from the Midwest and rippling outward east and west over roughly 1.5 seconds total. The headline crashes in from the left with a fast, punchy slide a beat after the first pins appear. This kinetic arrival makes the map feel alive and the brand's reach feel genuinely exciting.
12	
13	### Section Sequence & Rhythm
14	1. **Page Header (Stockists-1)** — Full-bleed teal panel with illustrated map. Maximum density, maximum energy. The loudest section.
15	2. **Item Grid (Stockists-2)** — Lava Cream background, four bold regional cards in a 2×2 grid. Mid-density, organized but still playful with color-coded region headers.
16	3. **Article List (Stockists-3)** — Ghost Pepper Purple full-bleed panel, three editorial partner profiles. Dense but warm, editorial rhythm. Color shift creates a strong narrative transition.
17	4. **Stats (Stockists-4)** — Habanero Yellow full-bleed panel, four oversized stat numerals in a horizontal row. Sparse, punchy, kinetic. The numbers dominate.
18	5. **CTA (Stockists-5)** — Lava Cream background with a bold Molten Coral left-border accent block and a Memphis-patterned background strip. Warm, inviting, asymmetric close.
19	
20	### Color & Surface Logic
21	- Section 1: Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) full-bleed background — the most graphic, energetic surface on the page.
22	- Section 2: Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) background — breathing room after the loud arrival; region cards use color-coded top bars (Coral, Teal, Yellow, Purple for the four regions).
23	- Section 3: Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) full-bleed panel — deep contrast anchor, editorial warmth; partner cards in Lava Cream with Smoke Ring Black text.
24	- Section 4: Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) full-bleed panel — energetic proof moment; numerals in Smoke Ring Black or Molten Coral.
25	- Section 5: Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) background with a thick Molten Coral left-side accent bar and a Habanero Yellow Memphis dot-pattern strip running horizontally across the top of the section.
26	
27	### Typography Hierarchy
28	- H1 (Section 1): Boogaloo 88px all-caps, Molten Coral, overlapping the map illustration
29	- H2 (Sections 2, 3, 5): Boogaloo 56px sentence case, color varies by section surface
30	- H2 (Section 4): Boogaloo 48px all-caps, Smoke Ring Black on yellow
31	- Stat numerals (Section 4): Boogaloo 96–112px, alternating Molten Coral and Smoke Ring Black
32	- Eyebrow labels: Permanent Marker 12px, loose tracking, on pill backgrounds (Confetti Pink or Habanero Yellow)
33	- Body/descriptions: Nunito 16–17px, 1.7 line-height, Smoke Ring Black on light, Lava Cream on dark
34	- Region/partner titles: Boogaloo 32px, color-coded per section context
35	- Partner metadata tags: Nunito 13px semi-bold, in Sauce Bottle Green or Habanero Yellow pill badges
36	
37	### Memphis Visual Language
38	- Abstract squiggles (Confetti Pink, Habanero Yellow) appear in Section 1 overlapping the map and headline, and again in Section 5 scattered behind the CTA block
39	- Confetti dot clusters appear as decorative fills in Section 2 card corners and Section 4 background
40	- Bold outline strokes (Smoke Ring Black, 3–4px) on all cards, region headers, and the CTA block border
41	- Patterned backgrounds: Section 5 uses a repeating Memphis dot-grid pattern strip in Habanero Yellow across the section top
42	- Hard color blocks: Section 3 and Section 4 use full-bleed saturated panels with zero gradients — flat, graphic, committed
43	
44	### Density & Whitespace Logic
45	- Sections 1 and 4 are the densest visually (map + pins; oversized numerals) but use generous padding to let the graphic elements breathe
46	- Section 2 uses a comfortable 48px section padding with 24px card gaps — organized but not sterile
47	- Section 3 is the most editorial — wider line measure, more vertical breathing between partner cards
48	- Section 5 is the sparsest — intentional open space to make the invitation feel unhurried
49	
50	### Motion Design (Full Page)
51	
52	**On-Load Arc (Section 1):**
53	- The teal background panel floods in from left to right as a color wipe over ~400ms as the page loads
54	- The illustrated map fades up from slight opacity while simultaneously scaling from 97% to 100% — a gentle arrival
55	- Flame/chili map pins pop in one by one in a staggered sequence (Midwest first, then rippling outward), each with a springy scale overshoot — this is the signature motion moment, completing over ~1.5 seconds
56	- The headline "Lava Mouth Is Out in the Wild" slides in from the left, fast and punchy, a beat after the first pins appear (~0.4s into the pin sequence)
57	- The eyebrow pill and subheadline fade up softly a beat after the headline settles
58	- Confetti Pink squiggles and Memphis shapes scattered across the panel drift in with a gentle fade — last to arrive, adding layered energy
59	
60	**Scroll-Triggered Reveals:**
61	- Section 2 (Item Grid): The section headline slides up and fades in first; then the four regional cards stagger in from bottom with a 100ms delay between each, left to right. Each card's colored top bar slides in from left to right independently as the card enters.
62	- Section 3 (Article List): The purple panel fades in as a full block; the three partner cards slide up sequentially with a 120ms stagger. The Memphis store-type icons scale in with a subtle bounce on each card's arrival.
63	- Section 4 (Stats): The four stat numerals count up from zero to their final values as they enter the viewport — the numbers increment rapidly at first then ease to their final value. The stat labels fade in just after each number finishes counting.
64	- Section 5 (CTA): The Habanero Yellow dot-pattern strip slides in from the right as the section enters. The CTA block fades up from below. The "Get in Touch" button pulses once gently on arrival to draw attention.
65	
66	**Hover & Focus Affordances:**
67	- Region cards (Section 2): On hover, the colored top bar expands downward by 8px, the card lifts 4px, and a Smoke Ring Black box shadow deepens. The region name color shifts to match its accent bar color.
68	- Featured partner cards (Section 3): On hover, the card border brightens to Habanero Yellow (from Smoke Ring Black), and the store-type icon scales up 10% with a quick snap.

PAGE INSTR:
## Stockists Page — Full Visual Design Direction

### Page Role & Emotional Arc
This page transforms a utilitarian stockist directory into an exciting discovery experience. The visitor should feel like they're unfolding a treasure map — Lava Mouth is *out there*, alive in the world, in real shops run by real people who believe in it. The scroll moves from geographic spectacle (the map header) → curated directory (regional grid) → editorial warmth (featured partners) → kinetic proof (stats) → open invitation (wholesale CTA). The rhythm deliberately alternates between loud graphic moments and warmer, more editorial pauses, mirroring the storytelling scroll structure.

### Signature Moment
**The Oversized Illustrated Map Header with Cascading Flame Pins** — Section 1 is the page's defining visual event. A full-bleed, flat-illustrated Memphis-style map of the continental US spans the entire viewport width, rendered in Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) with bold Smoke Ring Black outlines, sitting on a Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) background panel. Molten Coral flame/chili pin markers dot the map at stockist-concentration cities, each pin slightly oversized and cartoonishly bold. The headline "Lava Mouth Is Out in the Wild" is set in Boogaloo at 88px, all-caps, in Molten Coral, crashing over the top-left of the map — not politely above it, but *overlapping* the map surface like a sticker slapped onto the illustration. Confetti Pink squiggles and abstract Memphis triangles and dots are scattered across the teal panel, overlapping both the map edges and the headline. This is unmistakably Memphis: loud, graphic, layered, and joyful. It belongs here because it makes the geographic proof of the brand's reach feel like a celebration rather than a data point.

### Signature Motion Moment
On page load, the flame/chili map pins *pop in* one by one across the map in a staggered sequence — each pin scales from 0 to 1 with a quick springy overshoot (scale past 1 then settle), starting from the Midwest and rippling outward east and west over roughly 1.5 seconds total. The headline crashes in from the left with a fast, punchy slide a beat after the first pins appear. This kinetic arrival makes the map feel alive and the brand's reach feel genuinely exciting.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
1. **Page Header (Stockists-1)** — Full-bleed teal panel with illustrated map. Maximum density, maximum energy. The loudest section.
2. **Item Grid (Stockists-2)** — Lava Cream background, four bold regional cards in a 2×2 grid. Mid-density, organized but still playful with color-coded region headers.
3. **Article List (Stockists-3)** — Ghost Pepper Purple full-bleed panel, three editorial partner profiles. Dense but warm, editorial rhythm. Color shift creates a strong narrative transition.
4. **Stats (Stockists-4)** — Habanero Yellow full-bleed panel, four oversized stat numerals in a horizontal row. Sparse, punchy, kinetic. The numbers dominate.
5. **CTA (Stockists-5)** — Lava Cream background with a bold Molten Coral left-border accent block and a Memphis-patterned background strip. Warm, inviting, asymmetric close.

### Color & Surface Logic
- Section 1: Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) full-bleed background — the most graphic, energetic surface on the page.
- Section 2: Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) background — breathing room after the loud arrival; region cards use color-coded top bars (Coral, Teal, Yellow, Purple for the four regions).
- Section 3: Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) full-bleed panel — deep contrast anchor, editorial warmth; partner cards in Lava Cream with Smoke Ring Black text.
- Section 4: Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) full-bleed panel — energetic proof moment; numerals in Smoke Ring Black or Molten Coral.
- Section 5: Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) background with a thick Molten Coral left-side accent bar and a Habanero Yellow Memphis dot-pattern strip running horizontally across the top of the section.

### Typography Hierarchy
- H1 (Section 1): Boogaloo 88px all-caps, Molten Coral, overlapping the map illustration
- H2 (Sections 2, 3, 5): Boogaloo 56px sentence case, color varies by section surface
- H2 (Section 4): Boogaloo 48px all-caps, Smoke Ring Black on yellow
- Stat numerals (Section 4): Boogaloo 96–112px, alternating Molten Coral and Smoke Ring Black
- Eyebrow labels: Permanent Marker 12px, loose tracking, on pill backgrounds (Confetti Pink or Habanero Yellow)
- Body/descriptions: Nunito 16–17px, 1.7 line-height, Smoke Ring Black on light, Lava Cream on dark
- Region/partner titles: Boogaloo 32px, color-coded per section context
- Partner metadata tags: Nunito 13px semi-bold, in Sauce Bottle Green or Habanero Yellow pill badges

### Memphis Visual Language
- Abstract squiggles (Confetti Pink, Habanero Yellow) appear in Section 1 overlapping the map and headline, and again in Section 5 scattered behind the CTA block
- Confetti dot clusters appear as decorative fills in Section 2 card corners and Section 4 background
- Bold outline strokes (Smoke Ring Black, 3–4px) on all cards, region headers, and the CTA block border
- Patterned backgrounds: Section 5 uses a repeating Memphis dot-grid pattern strip in Habanero Yellow across the section top
- Hard color blocks: Section 3 and Section 4 use full-bleed saturated panels with zero gradients — flat, graphic, committed

### Density & Whitespace Logic
- Sections 1 and 4 are the densest visually (map + pins; oversized numerals) but use generous padding to let the graphic elements breathe
- Section 2 uses a comfortable 48px section padding with 24px card gaps — organized but not sterile
- Section 3 is the most editorial — wider line measure, more vertical breathing between partner cards
- Section 5 is the sparsest — intentional open space to make the invitation feel unhurried

### Motion Design (Full Page)

**On-Load Arc (Section 1):**
- The teal background panel floods in from left to right as a color wipe over ~400ms as the page loads
- The illustrated map fades up from slight opacity while simultaneously scaling from 97% to 100% — a gentle arrival
- Flame/chili map pins pop in one by one in a staggered sequence (Midwest first, then rippling outward), each with a springy scale overshoot — this is the signature motion moment, completing over ~1.5 seconds
- The headline "Lava Mouth Is Out in the Wild" slides in from the left, fast and punchy, a beat after the first pins appear (~0.4s into the pin sequence)
- The eyebrow pill and subheadline fade up softly a beat after the headline settles
- Confetti Pink squiggles and Memphis shapes scattered across the panel drift in with a gentle fade — last to arrive, adding layered energy

**Scroll-Triggered Reveals:**
- Section 2 (Item Grid): The section headline slides up and fades in first; then the four regional cards stagger in from bottom with a 100ms delay between each, left to right. Each card's colored top bar slides in from left to right independently as the card enters.
- Section 3 (Article List): The purple panel fades in as a full block; the three partner cards slide up sequentially with a 120ms stagger. The Memphis store-type icons scale in with a subtle bounce on each card's arrival.
- Section 4 (Stats): The four stat numerals count up from zero to their final values as they enter the viewport — the numbers increment rapidly at first then ease to their final value. The stat labels fade in just after each number finishes counting.
- Section 5 (CTA): The Habanero Yellow dot-pattern strip slides in from the right as the section enters. The CTA block fades up from below. The "Get in Touch" button pulses once gently on arrival to draw attention.

**Hover & Focus Affordances:**
- Region cards (Section 2): On hover, the colored top bar expands downward by 8px, the card lifts 4px, and a Smoke Ring Black box shadow deepens. The region name color shifts to match its accent bar color.
- Featured partner cards (Section 3): On hover, the card border brightens to Habanero Yellow (from Smoke Ring Black), and the store-type icon scales up 10% with a quick snap.
- Stat blocks (Section 4): On hover, the individual stat number scales up 5% with a quick ease — subtle acknowledgment without breaking the grid.
- "Get in Touch" CTA button (Section 5): On hover, the button background shifts from Molten Coral to Ghost Pepper Purple with a fast 150ms transition; the button lifts 3px and the shadow deepens. On keyboard focus, a thick Habanero Yellow outline appears.
- Map pins (Section 1): On hover over individual pin markers, a small tooltip-style label pops up showing the city name — scales from 0 with a quick springy ease.

**Ambient Looped Motion:**
- The flame/chili map pins in Section 1 have a slow, subtle breathing pulse (scale 1.0 → 1.06 → 1.0) on a staggered loop — each pin pulses independently on a slightly different interval, making the map feel alive and in motion at all times. This is the ambient extension of the signature motion moment.
- The Confetti Pink squiggles in Section 1 drift very slowly (a gentle 3–4px vertical oscillation on a 4-second loop), adding kinetic texture to the background without distracting from the map.
- The "Get in Touch" button in Section 5 has a slow ambient pulse on its box shadow (shadow grows and fades on a 2.5-second loop) to maintain a gentle invitation energy.

### Responsive Behavior
- Mobile (< 768px): Section 1 map scales down and pins reduce in size; headline drops to 52px and sits above the map rather than overlapping; squiggles reduce in count. Section 2 grid collapses to 1-column stacked cards. Section 3 partner cards stack vertically. Section 4 stats wrap to 2×2 grid, numerals at 72px. Section 5 CTA stacks with the accent bar moving to top border.
- Tablet (768–1024px): Section 2 goes 2×2. Section 3 stays single column but with wider editorial measure. Section 4 stays 4-across at reduced numeral size (80px). Section 1 map scales proportionally.
- Desktop (1024px+): Full layouts as described per section. Map fills 100vw. Stats in a single horizontal row.

### Cross-Page Fit
This page uses the same Boogaloo/Nunito/Permanent Marker type system and the same Memphis visual language as the rest of the site, but its dominant surfaces — Jalapeño Teal (Section 1), Ghost Pepper Purple (Section 3), and Habanero Yellow (Section 4) — give it a distinct color identity that differentiates it from the Home page (Coral-dominant) and the Story page (more editorial/cream-dominant). The illustrated map is the page's unique asset — nothing else on the site uses illustrated cartography, making this page immediately recognizable in the site's visual vocabulary.
===

SECTION ID: stockists-section-1
SECTION 1 — PAGE HEADER: Full-bleed Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) background panel spanning 100vw. Minimum height of 90vh on desktop to give the illustrated map room to dominate. The illustrated flat map of the continental United States is the primary visual — it spans roughly 70% of the section width, positioned center-right, rendered in Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) with bold 3px Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) outline strokes on state borders and landmass edges. The map sits slightly low in the panel, with its bottom edge bleeding off the section boundary, reinforcing the 'out in the wild' spatial metaphor. Flame/chili icon map pins in Molten Coral (#FF4D38) with Smoke Ring Black outlines mark stockist concentration cities — roughly 12–15 pins visible at varying sizes (larger for denser markets like Chicago, NYC, LA; smaller for secondary markets). Each pin is cartoonishly oversized and bold, consistent with Memphis graphic language.

The headline 'LAVA MOUTH IS OUT IN THE WILD' is set in Boogaloo at 88px, all-caps, in Molten Coral (#FF4D38) with a subtle 2px Smoke Ring Black text shadow offset 3px down-right for depth. It is positioned top-left, overlapping the map illustration — the text physically crashes over the map's western states, sitting at approximately 15% from the left edge and 18% from the top of the section. This overlap is intentional and essential: it signals Memphis layering energy and refuses the polite text-left / image-right split.

The eyebrow label 'Find the Fire' is set in Permanent Marker at 13px, loose letter-spacing (+0.08em), in Smoke Ring Black on a Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) pill badge, positioned above the headline with 12px margin. The pill has a 2px Smoke Ring Black border and 8px border-radius.

The subheadline '85+ shops, grocers, and restaurants across the country are already carrying the heat. Is yours?' is set in Nunito semi-bold 600 at 20px, Smoke Ring Black, positioned below the headline with 20px top margin. Max-width 480px, left-aligned under the headline block.

Decorative Memphis elements: three Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) abstract squiggles are scattered across the teal panel — one overlapping the top-left corner near the headline, one in the mid-right area above the map, one at the bottom-left. These are irregular, hand-drawn-style vector shapes at 60–80px scale. Additionally, four to five small abstract shapes (triangles, circles, zigzag strips) in Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) and Habanero Yellow are scattered across the panel, never touching the headline or map pins. All decorative elements have the same 2–3px Smoke Ring Black outline stroke.

The map asset (as described in asset_ideas) is placed center-right, behind the headline text but above the teal background. The map's placement reinforces the asymmetric composition — text lives on the left, geography on the right, with the headline boldly crossing the boundary between them.

MOTION: On page load, the teal background floods in from left to right as a color wipe over ~400ms. The map fades up from 0 opacity while scaling from 97% to 100% over ~500ms, starting ~200ms after the background wipe begins. The flame/chili pins pop in one by one in a staggered sequence — each pin scales from 0 to 1.1 then settles to 1.0 (springy overshoot), starting from the Midwest cluster and rippling outward east and west, with roughly 80ms between each pin, completing over ~1.5 seconds total. This is the signature motion moment. The headline slides in from the left (translateX -60px to 0) with a fast, punchy ease, firing ~400ms into the pin sequence. The eyebrow pill and subheadline fade up a beat after the headline settles. The Confetti Pink squiggles drift in last with a gentle fade, adding layered energy. After load, the map pins breathe on a slow ambient pulse (scale 1.0 → 1.06 → 1.0) each on slightly staggered independent loops (~3–5 second intervals), making the map feel alive. The squiggles oscillate gently with a 3–4px vertical drift on a 4-second loop. On hover over individual map pins, a small city-name tooltip scales in from 0 with a quick springy ease.

SECTION ID: stockists-section-2
SECTION 2 — ITEM GRID (Regional Stockist Directory): Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) background — a deliberate decompression after the loud teal arrival. 80px top/bottom padding on desktop. The section provides breathing room while maintaining Memphis energy through bold color-coded cards.

Section header block: left-aligned, max-width 600px. Eyebrow 'Where to Find Us' in Permanent Marker 12px, Smoke Ring Black on Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) pill badge, 2px Smoke Ring Black border. Headline 'Our Stockist Family' in Boogaloo 56px, sentence case, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) — grounded and readable after the loud header. Subheadline 'From corner stores to specialty grocers — these are the spots that get it.' in Nunito semi-bold 600 at 18px, Smoke Ring Black, 28px below headline. 48px gap between the header block and the card grid.

Card grid: 2×2 layout on desktop, each card occupying roughly 45% width with 24px gap. Cards have a Lava Cream fill, a bold 3px Smoke Ring Black border, and a 6px border-radius. Each card has a thick 8px top color bar that acts as the regional identifier:
- Midwest: Molten Coral (#FF4D38) top bar
- Northeast: Jalapeño Teal (#00B8A0) top bar
- South: Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) top bar
- West: Sauce Bottle Green (#1D7A3A) top bar

Inside each card: the region name (e.g., 'Midwest') in Boogaloo 32px, colored to match its top bar, positioned 20px below the bar. Below the region name, a small Permanent Marker 11px badge in Smoke Ring Black on a Habanero Yellow pill shows the location count (e.g., '18 locations'). Below that, the list of stockist names and cities is set in Nunito regular 400 at 15px, Smoke Ring Black, line-height 1.8, each entry on its own line. Card internal padding: 24px on all sides. A small abstract Memphis shape (triangle or circle, 20px, matching the bar color, with Smoke Ring Black outline) is placed in the bottom-right corner of each card as a decorative confetti accent.

The 2×2 grid is left-aligned within the section container (max-width 1100px, centered on page), not centered as a block — the left edge of the grid aligns with the section headline, creating a clean left-axis that resists the default centered-everything template.

MOTION: As the section enters the viewport, the section headline slides up and fades in first (translateY 30px → 0, opacity 0 → 1, ~300ms ease-out). Then the four regional cards stagger in from below — each card slides up 40px and fades in with a 100ms delay between cards, left to right (Midwest, Northeast, South, West). Each card's colored top bar slides in from the left edge to full width independently as the card arrives, taking ~200ms. On hover, the card lifts 4px (translateY -4px), the Smoke Ring Black box shadow deepens from 2px to 8px offset, and the top bar expands downward by 8px. The region name color briefly brightens (opacity boost) on hover. Keyboard focus mirrors the hover state with a Habanero Yellow outline ring.

SECTION ID: stockists-section-3
SECTION 3 — ARTICLE LIST (Featured Partners): Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) full-bleed background panel — the most dramatic color shift on the page, creating a strong narrative transition that signals 'these shops are special.' This is the editorial heart of the page. 80px top/bottom padding.

Section header: left-aligned within a max-width 1100px container. Eyebrow 'Featured Partners' in Permanent Marker 12px, Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) text on a Smoke Ring Black pill badge (inverted from earlier pill treatment — dark pill on dark background for contrast). Headline 'Shops That Really Get It' in Boogaloo 56px, Habanero Yellow (#FFD600), sentence case — the yellow on purple is a high-contrast Memphis power move. Subheadline 'These stockists don't just carry Lava Mouth — they champion it.' in Nunito semi-bold 600 at 18px, Lava Cream (#FFF5E1), 24px below headline. 48px gap between header and partner cards.

Partner cards layout: three cards in a single horizontal row on desktop, each card roughly 30% width with 28px gaps. Each card has a Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) fill, 3px Smoke Ring Black border, 8px border-radius. Inside each card:
- Top: The Memphis store-type icon (from asset_ideas — specialty grocer storefront, retail shelf with bottles, independent market stall) rendered at 56px, positioned top-left inside the card with 20px padding. Icons use Smoke Ring Black fills with Molten Coral accent details, consistent with Memphis graphic style.
- Below icon: A metadata tag row — the store type (e.g., 'Specialty Grocer') in a Sauce Bottle Green (#1D7A3A) pill badge, Nunito semi-bold 12px, Lava Cream text; and the city (e.g., 'Chicago, IL') in a Habanero Yellow pill badge, Nunito semi-bold 12px, Smoke Ring Black text. Both pills sit inline with 8px gap.
- Partner name (e.g., 'Logan Square Provisions, Chicago') in Boogaloo 28px, Smoke Ring Black, 12px below the badges.
- Description paragraph in Nunito regular 400 at 15px, Smoke Ring Black, line-height 1.75, 10px below the name. Max 3 lines visible by default.
- Card internal padding: 24px.

A decorative Confetti Pink squiggle motif (20–30px) is placed in the top-right corner of each card, overlapping the card border slightly — echoing the layered Memphis sticker energy from Section 1.

The three-card row sits on the purple panel with no additional background treatment — the contrast between the Lava Cream cards and the Ghost Pepper Purple background does all the visual work.

MOTION: As the section enters the viewport, the Ghost Pepper Purple panel fades in as a full block (opacity 0 → 1 over ~400ms). The section headline slides up and fades in first. Then the three partner cards slide up sequentially (120ms stagger between each) from 40px below their final position. The Memphis store-type icon on each card scales in with a subtle bounce (scale 0 → 1.1 → 1.0) just as the card settles into place. On hover, the card's Smoke Ring Black border shifts to Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) over 150ms, and the store-type icon scales up 10% with a quick snap. The Confetti Pink squiggle in the corner rotates 15 degrees on hover for a playful acknowledgment.
---

SECTION ID: stockists-section-4
SECTION 4 — STATS: Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) full-bleed background panel — a complete surface shift from the purple above, creating a bold graphic punch. This is the sparsest, most kinetic section on the page. 72px top/bottom padding.

Section header: centered on desktop (this is one of the rare centered moments, justified because the stats row below is also centered and the symmetry creates a satisfying graphic block against the loud yellow). Eyebrow 'The Network' in Permanent Marker 12px, Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) text on a Smoke Ring Black pill badge. Headline 'Growing Every Month' in Boogaloo 48px, all-caps, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), centered, 16px below eyebrow. 40px gap between headline and stats row.

Stats row: four stat blocks arranged in a single horizontal row on desktop, each occupying 25% width, centered within the row. Each stat block:
- The numeral (e.g., '85+', '22', '3', '100%') in Boogaloo at 104px, alternating between Molten Coral (#FF4D38) and Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209) — first and third in Molten Coral, second and fourth in Smoke Ring Black. This alternation creates a rhythmic Memphis color beat across the row.
- The description label (e.g., 'Active stockist locations nationwide') in Nunito semi-bold 600 at 15px, Smoke Ring Black, centered, max-width 160px, line-height 1.5, 8px below the numeral.
- Each stat block has no card border or background — the numerals float directly on the yellow, giving the section a raw, graphic feel.
- A small abstract Memphis dot cluster (5–6 dots, 6px each, in Ghost Pepper Purple or Molten Coral) is scattered near the bottom of each stat block as a confetti accent, never touching the numeral itself.

A thin 3px Smoke Ring Black horizontal rule runs above and below the stats row, full section width, reinforcing the hard-border Memphis aesthetic.

MOTION: As the section enters the viewport, the Habanero Yellow panel does not animate — it arrives instantly as a hard cut, reinforcing the graphic block energy. The section headline fades in first. Then the four stat numerals count up from zero to their final values as they enter the viewport — numbers increment rapidly at first then ease to their final value over ~1.2 seconds (a classic counter animation). The stat description labels fade in just after each number finishes counting, with a 60ms delay per label. On hover over an individual stat block, the numeral scales up 6% with a quick 120ms ease — a subtle acknowledgment of interactivity. The horizontal rules above and below the stats row extend from center outward (width 0% → 100%) as the section enters, taking ~400ms — a structural motion gesture that frames the stats like a stage.
---

SECTION ID: stockists-section-5
SECTION 5 — CTA (Wholesale Invitation): Lava Cream (#FFF5E1) background — a warm, unhurried close after the kinetic yellow stats section. This section uses asymmetric composition to avoid the default centered-CTA template. 80px top/bottom padding.

A bold 8px Molten Coral (#FF4D38) vertical accent bar runs the full height of the content block on the left edge — like a bookmarked margin rule, it anchors the layout to the left axis and signals 'this is important.' This bar is 8px wide, the full height of the text content block, with no border-radius — hard-edged and graphic.

A Habanero Yellow (#FFD600) Memphis dot-grid pattern strip (repeating small dots, ~8px diameter, 20px spacing, in a regular grid) runs horizontally across the full section width at the very top, approximately 40px tall, acting as a visual divider from the yellow stats section above. This strip has a 2px Smoke Ring Black bottom border.

Content layout: left-aligned text block, offset 32px from the Molten Coral accent bar. Max-width 640px. Eyebrow 'Carry the Heat' in Permanent Marker 12px, Smoke Ring Black on Confetti Pink (#FF85A1) pill badge, 2px Smoke Ring Black border. Headline 'Want to Stock Lava Mouth in Your Shop?' in Boogaloo 56px, sentence case, Smoke Ring Black (#1A1209), 16px below eyebrow. Subheadline 'We work with independent retailers, specialty grocers, restaurants, and food halls. Let's talk.' in Nunito semi-bold 600 at 18px, Smoke Ring Black, 20px below headline. Body copy 'We keep our wholesale program small and personal. Every new stockist gets a tasting kit, a shelf guide, and a direct line to Dani. We're not looking for volume — we're looking for the right shops.' in Nunito regular 400 at 16px, line-height 1.75, Smoke Ring Black, max-width 560px, 16px below subheadline.

CTA button 'Get in Touch' positioned 28px below the body copy, left-aligned (not centered). Button uses Molten Coral (#FF4D38) fill, Lava Cream text in Boogaloo 20px, 20px top/bottom padding, 40px left/right padding, 4px border-radius, 3px Smoke Ring Black border. The button is deliberately left-aligned to maintain the left-axis composition — centered buttons would break the asymmetric structure.

Right side of the section (the remaining ~40% of the desktop width, to the right of the text block): a cluster of Memphis decorative shapes — two Confetti Pink squiggles, one Habanero Yellow abstract triangle, one Ghost Pepper Purple circle outline, and one Molten Coral zigzag strip — scattered loosely in this area, some overlapping each other and the section's right edge. These shapes are 40–80px in scale, all with 2–3px Smoke Ring Black outlines. They fill the visual space without competing with the text, reinforcing the Memphis energy even in the most relaxed section of the page.

MOTION: As the section enters the viewport, the Habanero Yellow dot-pattern strip at the top slides in from the right (translateX 100% → 0) over ~400ms. The Molten Coral vertical accent bar grows from top to bottom (height 0 → full) over ~350ms. The text content block (eyebrow, headline, subheadline, body) fades up from 30px below in a staggered sequence — eyebrow first, then headline, then subheadline, then body, each ~80ms apart. The CTA button fades in last with a single gentle pulse (scale 1.0 → 1.04 → 1.0) to draw attention. The Memphis decorative shapes in the right area drift in with staggered fades, each from a slightly different direction (one from right, one from bottom, one rotating slightly as it appears). After load, the CTA button has a slow ambient pulse on its box shadow (shadow grows and fades on a 2.5-second loop). On hover, the button background shifts from Molten Coral to Ghost Pepper Purple (#7B2FBE) over 150ms, the button lifts 3px (translateY -3px), and the shadow deepens. On keyboard focus, a thick 3px Habanero Yellow outline ring appears around the button.

content.content:
1	PAGE INSTR:
2	**Contact Page — Lava Mouth | "We're Real People Who Really Love Hot Sauce"**
3	
4	**Page Role & Goal**
5	This is the warmest, most human page on the site. It must feel like knocking on a kitchen door and being welcomed in — not submitting a ticket to a help center. The Memphis Playful aesthetic is fully deployed, but dialed toward warmth and invitation rather than pure spectacle. The storytelling scroll structure moves visitors from welcome → self-identification → action → human connection → self-service, each section shifting rhythm and density to prevent monotony.
6	
7	**Section Sequence & Rhythm**
8	1. **Page Header** — Full-bleed, loud arrival. Asymmetric type composition, Molten Coral headline fill, confetti shapes scattered across the panel. Dense and energetic.
9	2. **Feature Grid** — Four inquiry-type cards on a Habanero Yellow background block. Memphis illustration anchors the composition off-center. Grid breaks from the header's full-bleed by introducing contained card forms. Medium density.
10	3. **Contact Block** — The form. Lava Cream surface, deliberate sparse breathing room. The only quiet moment on the page — stillness signals focus and low friction. Minimal ornament.
11	4. **Story Block** — Founder note. Ghost Pepper Purple full-bleed panel, white and Habanero Yellow type. Feels like a handwritten letter pinned to a bulletin board. Dense emotionally, sparse structurally. The page's **signature visual moment** lives here (see below).
12	5. **FAQ** — Jalapeño Teal background, accordion-style stacked questions. Ends with a CTA chip pointing to Stockists. Returns to medium density with bold typographic rhythm.
13	
14	**Signature Visual Moment**
15	The **Story Block (Section 4)** is the page's signature moment. The word "DANI" is set in Boogaloo at approximately 160–180px, all-caps, in Habanero Yellow with a Smoke Ring Black outline stroke, running diagonally at a slight upward angle (roughly 6–8°) behind the founder's quote text like a watermark that refuses to be a watermark — it bleeds off the right edge of the panel and partially off the bottom. The founder's body copy sits in Nunito Regular 18px in Lava Cream, left-aligned, overlapping the oversized name. A Confetti Pink squiggle rule separates the eyebrow from the headline. This is unmistakably Memphis: graphic type used as texture, color as contrast anchor, and the irreverent energy of a sauce label applied to a personal founder note. It is not imported from any other aesthetic — it is the logical conclusion of Boogaloo at display scale meeting a saturated full-bleed panel.
16	
17	**Signature Motion Moment**
18	Tied to the Story Block: as the section scrolls into view, the oversized "DANI" letterform slides in from the right edge — slowly, over about 700ms — as if the name is arriving late to its own introduction, settling into its diagonal position just as the founder copy fades up. This staggered entrance makes the typographic stunt feel alive and intentional rather than static decoration.
19	
20	**Color & Surface Logic**
21	- Section 1 (Header): Lava Cream background, Molten Coral headline, Smoke Ring Black body, Confetti Pink and Habanero Yellow confetti shapes scattered at large scale.
22	- Section 2 (Feature Grid): Habanero Yellow full-bleed background panel, cards in Lava Cream with Smoke Ring Black text, Molten Coral card-top accent bars, Jalapeño Teal email links.
23	- Section 3 (Contact Form): Lava Cream background, Ghost Pepper Purple form field labels, Molten Coral submit button, Jalapeño Teal focus rings on inputs.
24	- Section 4 (Story Block): Ghost Pepper Purple full-bleed background, Habanero Yellow oversized "DANI" type, Lava Cream body copy, Confetti Pink squiggle rule, Sauce Bottle Green eyebrow pill.
25	- Section 5 (FAQ): Jalapeño Teal background, Lava Cream accordion rows, Smoke Ring Black question text, Habanero Yellow open/close chevron icons, Molten Coral CTA chip.
26	
27	**Typographic Hierarchy**
28	- H1 (Section 1): Boogaloo 80–90px, Molten Coral fill, sentence case, tight tracking.
29	- H2 (Sections 2, 3, 4, 5): Boogaloo 52–60px, color varies by section surface.
30	- Eyebrows: Permanent Marker 12–13px, loose tracking, on pill backgrounds matching section accent.
31	- Body: Nunito 16–18px, 1.7 line-height, Regular or Semi-bold 600 for intros.
32	- Form labels: Nunito Semi-bold 600, 14px, Ghost Pepper Purple.
33	- FAQ questions: Nunito Bold 700, 18px, Smoke Ring Black on Lava Cream rows.
34	- Oversized "DANI" watermark: Boogaloo ~170px, Habanero Yellow, Smoke Ring Black outline, diagonal.
35	
36	**Density & Whitespace Logic**
37	The page alternates between dense/energetic (Sections 1, 2, 4) and sparse/focused (Sections 3, 5). Section 3 is the page's quietest moment — generous padding (100px top/bottom), maximum 640px form width centered, no decorative ornament — so the form feels approachable, not buried. Section 5 returns to medium density with the accordion rhythm.
38	
39	**Motion Design — Full Arc**
40	- **On-load (Section 1):** The Molten Coral headline ("We're Real People Who Really Love Hot Sauce") slides up from 24px below its final position and fades in over ~500ms. A beat after it settles, the subheadline fades up. Then, the confetti shapes (Confetti Pink circles, Habanero Yellow triangles, Jalapeño Teal squiggles) pop in one by one in a staggered sequence — each shape scaling from 0 to full size with a slight bounce — over about 800ms total. The eyebrow pill slides in from the left before the headline arrives.
41	- **Scroll-triggered reveals:** Each section's headline and body stagger-fade up (translate Y 20px → 0, opacity 0 → 1) as they enter the viewport via IntersectionObserver. Section 2 cards stagger in left-to-right with a 100ms delay between each card. Section 5 FAQ rows stagger in top-to-bottom.
42	- **Hover affordances:** Feature grid cards (Section 2) lift 5px with a deepened Smoke Ring Black box shadow and the top accent bar shifts from Molten Coral to Jalapeño Teal on hover. Email links in cards underline-grow from left on hover. The "Send It" submit button scales to 1.04 and shifts background from Molten Coral to Ghost Pepper Purple on hover. FAQ accordion rows show a Habanero Yellow left border (4px) on hover before click. The "Find a Stockist" CTA chip in Section 5 fills with Molten Coral on hover with white text.
43	- **Ambient looped motion:** The confetti shapes in Section 1 have a slow, continuous floating drift — each shape independently oscillating 6–8px up and down on a staggered sine-wave loop (roughly 3–4 second cycles, offset per shape) so the header feels alive without being distracting. The Memphis illustration in Section 2 (open envelope with chili pepper) has a very subtle slow rotation oscillation — ±3° over a 4-second loop — like it's gently breathing.
44	- **Signature motion moment:** As Section 4 (Story Block) enters the viewport, the oversized "DANI" letterform slides in from the right edge over ~700ms with an ease-out curve, settling into its diagonal position behind the copy. A half-beat later, the founder body copy fades up from 16px below. The Confetti Pink squiggle rule draws in left-to-right (width animates from 0 to full) just before the headline arrives. Together these three moves create a layered cinematic reveal that makes the signature moment feel earned.
45	
46	**Responsive Behavior**
47	- Mobile (< 640px): Section 1 headline drops to 52px, confetti shapes reduce in count and scale. Section 2 cards stack to single column. Section 3 form goes full-width with 24px horizontal padding. Section 4 oversized "DANI" scales to ~90px and shifts to horizontal (non-diagonal) to remain legible at small widths. Section 5 accordion goes full-width single column.
48	- Tablet (640–1024px): Section 2 cards go 2×2 grid. Section 4 maintains diagonal treatment at reduced scale (~120px). All other sections maintain single-column centered with generous side padding.
49	- Desktop (> 1024px): Full compositions as described above, max-width container ~1280px centered.
50	
51	**Fit Within Shared Design System**
52	This page uses every palette color at least once, deploys Boogaloo at multiple display scales, uses Permanent Marker for all eyebrow pills, and uses Nunito for all body and form text. It is the most restrained page in the set (the form section is genuinely quiet) while still being unmistakably Lava Mouth. The signature moment (oversized diagonal "DANI" in the Ghost Pepper Purple panel) is the loudest single typographic gesture on any page in the site, which is appropriate for the final page of a storytelling scroll — it ends with a human name, not a product shot.
